jobs.title: Retail Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**.We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on\-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build\-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field\-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre\-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on\-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build\-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross\-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full\-time, Monday through Friday 10am\-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In\-person interview with the operations leadership team

Pay: $26\.44 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in project management in retail or construction?

Experience:

* Project management: 1 year (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Service Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

Under the direction of the Sales Manager and assigned Project Manager(s), this position is responsible for providing administrative support for the Service Sales Engineers, Project Management Team, and Plumbing Field Team.  



**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

Schedule and Route Optimization


The Project Coordinator acts as the dedicated bridge between Dispatch, the Field, and our Clients. Call centers and dispatch teams are built for speed, volume, and immediate routing; they get bogged down when forced to manage multi\-step, ongoing issues. This role takes ownership of those escalated, long\-term, or high\-tier requests, providing "white\-glove" oversight to ensure complex jobs are executed flawlessly from intake to completion.  

* 

Key Responsibilities


* Take ownership of escalated or complex service tickets handed off from Dispatch or PM’s.
* Serve as the dedicated, single point of contact for clients requiring multi\-step service or project fulfillment.
* Coordinate schedules, parts, resources, and communications between field technicians, internal departments, and third\-party vendors.
* Monitor ongoing project timelines to ensure longer\-term deliverables do not stall or fall through the cracks.
* Proactively update clients on the status of their service requests to eliminate inbound follow\-up calls to the dispatch team.
* Maintain accurate, detailed records of complex cases within the company’s CRM or project management software.
* Board Management: Constantly shifting the puzzle pieces throughout the day as jobs run long or finish early. A PC is always thinking two moves ahead.
* Skill Matching: Assigning complex jobs to senior technicians, while routing simpler tasks to junior techs.
* Equipment Assignment: Scheduling out equipment to techs for high level tracking.
Last Calls: Pushing to get last calls covered.  
* 

Call Triage and Customer Service


* Prevent Technicians from responding without necessary context: Technicians need enough information to mentally prepare for the diagnosis, grab the right tools out of the truck, and approach the customer with the right tone. Ask probing questions during the intake call helps set our technicians up for success while on site. "Plumbing leak" does not provide enough of a description to provide the proper level of service. Technicians need to know the location, severity, and context of the issue so they know what to expect. The Project Coordinator helps fill any gaps prior to arriving on site.
* Emergency Triage: Differentiate between a true emergency and a nuisance issue and prioritize the schedule accordingly.
* Setting Expectations: Communicating arrival windows clearly and sending "on the way" notifications so customers aren't left guessing.
* De\-escalation: Handling frustrated customers if a technician is running behind due to a previous job running long.
Empathy: Customer State of Mind\- (Urgency) Customer is frantic, water is actively destroying property. (Frustrating) Customer is annoyed, possible call back, invoice cost issue. Your role is to discern the situation and handle as a top priority for high level customer service.  
* 

Technician Support and Liaison


* Debriefing: Requiring techs to call or message in after every job to close out the ticket, ensure notes are accurate, and clear them for the next call.
* Logistical Support: Coordinating with parts supply houses if a tech needs a specific part or arranging for a junior tech to drop off a part to a senior tech on a big job.
* Gatekeeping: Making sure techs are on schedule and direct communication with techs and customers.
Safety tool box talk documentation and tracking.  
* 

Administrative and CRM Management


* Data Integrity: Ensuring all customer information is updated (new chief engineer,) property rules and regs, entry codes, and job histories are accurately entered into the CRM.
* Permit Coordination: Assisting with pulling municipal permits for major work like sewer replacements or gas line repairs.
* On Call Calendar: Assigning tech to the on call schedule and managing holiday fairness.
* Backflow Portal Administrator: Entering in all backflow forms on agency portals.
* Track Service Calls: Notify the PM of a service call. Communicate with tech for any follow\-up work or gaps to fill.
* Take and distribute meeting minutes for sales and department team meetings; email recap with action items to meeting attendees
* Assist with onboarding new hires – coordinate with Human Resource to ensure that all first day activities are scheduled in advance, itinerary, meet \& greets, etc.
* Assist the manager with new hire equipment setup; ITPAFs, business cards, key fob/building access, email setup, etc. to ensure a successful onboarding process.
* Prequalification Support for approved RFP's and bids.
* IFS and Bid Tracer Super User – Generating reports for the Sales Manager that tracks individual sales activity
* Monitor proposal and bid activity levels in the three main business segments (Retrofit, Repairs \& Maintenance)
* Scheduling of Estimate reviews with sales personnel and the Sales Managers.
* Scheduling of Pre\-job planning and Risk Review meetings – Scheduling required attendees based upon scope and dollar amount i.e., RVP, SVP etc..
* Plans and organizes meetings for Service leadership, Sales Managers, salespeople and vendors as needed by the Sales Manager including rooms and catering (for both in person and virtual meetings as applicable)
* General administrative duties such as typing and photocopying general correspondence including, but not limited to: letters, proposals, presentations, reports, agreements, contracts, and memos from notes or sending and/or distributing various correspondences on behalf of Project Managers
* Maintain accurate filing system and project document control.
* Take and transcribe meeting notes.
Other tasks and duties as assigned by Sales Managers, direct supervisor and/or upper management  
*

* Oversee, supervise, and execute domestic and overseas purchasing
* Develop and implement inventory strategies with forecasted demand to optimize inventory levels across multiple divisions, minimizing excess stock and stockouts
* Monitor planners productivity and KPIs; including volume, value, fill rate, turns, and overstock
* Identify, evaluate, and establish relationships with key suppliers and vendors both internal and external
* Monitor supplier performance and resolve any issues related to quality, delivery, or pricing/billing in a timely manner
* Work alongside internal staff (R\&D, Sales, Customer Service, Operations, Accounting, Ownership) to optimize purchasing efforts, new product launches, and changes in product life cycles to maximize customer satisfaction
* Develop and present regular reports on inventory performance, inventory levels, and key performance metrics
* Foster a high\-performance team environment by mentoring and developing planner buyers

* Lead initiatives to streamline procurement processes, improve operational efficiencies, and enhance supplier relationships
* Collaborate with Division General Managers and Ownership to develop and implement long\-term strategies that support business growth and objectives
* Ensure purchasing activities comply with company policies, industry regulations, and relevant legal requirements
* Be a model leader for communicating with impact, ensuring that all needs across sales, demand planning, replenishment purchasing, and operations are met on time and to expectation
* Deliver the budgeted metrics and objectives of departments, ensuring that all strategic decisions are in sync within each division’s plan. Metrics may include, but are not limited to:
* Conformance to category management guidelines or demand plans that ensure preferred vendor relationships and products are core to every buying decision
* Inventory balance to ordering characteristics and aged profile
* Maintain vendor relationships including service level and OTIF
* Identification and capture of opportunities for one\-time improvements
* Serve as the functional expert and leader for ERP purchasing and accounting module tools (e.g. Rockwell’s Plex, or other ERPs)
* Be a thought leader capable of transitioning routinely purchased items to conform a priority purchasing model and associated stocking parameters
* As necessary, directly submit RFQ and negotiate with vendors on any required item to reach decision

Requirements:

* Import / Export knowledge
* Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred. Significant experience within the manufacturing industry.
* Deep knowledge of various supply chain principles including replenishment purchasing, freight, and warehousing.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite with solid analytical skills using Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* Strong preference for candidates with hands on MRP / ERP platforms
* Must possess managerial level planning, execution, time management, and keen communication skills with ability to craft targeted messages.

**National Sales Coordinator – Sales Support \& Customer Operations**
---------------------------------------------------------------------


**Full\-Time • Non\-Exempt • Office\-Based • Monday–Friday (Hybrid)**



We are seeking a detail\-oriented and customer\-focused **National Sales Coordinator** to join our team. In this fast\-paced, high\-volume role, you will serve as a key point of contact for customers and the Outside Sales team—managing inbound inquiries, processing orders, and ensuring a seamless customer experience from quote to delivery.



If you thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy multitasking, and take pride in delivering exceptional service while maintaining accuracy, this is a great opportunity to make a meaningful impact.



**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Serve as the primary contact for a high volume of inbound customer and Outside Sales inquiries related to product availability, pricing, order status, invoices, and order processing.
* Prepare and enter customer quotations into SAP, ensuring accuracy in pricing, product availability, and documentation.
* Accurately process sales orders, including pricing, payment terms, freight terms, and delivery timelines.
* Communicate order confirmations and proactively notify customers of any updates or changes.
* Monitor open orders and backorders; follow up regularly to ensure accurate lead times and timely customer communication.
* Coordinate closely with inventory and supply chain teams to resolve held or delayed orders and provide detailed updates.
* Partner with Outside Sales representatives to support customer accounts and maintain strong internal collaboration.
* Resolve customer issues and inquiries promptly, professionally, and with a solutions\-oriented mindset.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of company products and equipment to effectively support customers and sales initiatives.
* Perform additional duties as assigned to support business needs.

**What You Bring**
------------------


### **Experience \& Education**


* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* 3–5 years of experience in customer service, sales support, or order processing in a high\-volume environment.
* Experience in a call center or similar fast\-paced setting preferred.

### **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills**


* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to professionally engage with customers, sales teams, and cross\-functional departments.
* Customer\-first mindset with strong problem\-resolution abilities.

### **Technical \& Systems Skills**


* Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems preferred.
* Ability to learn and navigate internal systems and product information quickly.

### **Operational \& Organizational Skills**


* Highly detail\-oriented with strong multitasking and time management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with sound decision\-making.

### **Additional Qualifications**


* Ability to interpret company policies, procedures, and product information.
* Basic math skills, including calculating pricing adjustments, discounts, and freight percentages.
* Demonstrated professionalism, reliability, and a strong work ethic.
* Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team environment.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------


* Primarily sedentary role requiring extended periods of sitting.
* Frequent use of hands for typing, handling documents, and computer work.
* Regular communication via phone and computer.
* Occasional standing and walking.
* Ability to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds occasionally.
* Close vision required for computer\-based tasks.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

  


**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------


* $24\.00\-$26\.00/hr
* 11 paid Holidays
* Generous Paid Time Off — accrue up to 4 weeks per year
* Excellent Benefits Package starting the 1st of the month after 30 days of employment, including:
	+ Medical, Dental \& Vision (including orthodontics)
	+ Company‑paid Life, AD\&D, Short‑Term \& Long‑Term Disability
	+ Flex Spending Account (FSA), accident plans, and supplemental options
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250 annually

jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** HR Operations Coordinator

**DEPARTMENT:** Human Resources \& Operations

**REPORTS TO:** Human Resources Manager / Executive Leadership

**JOB TYPE:** Full\-time, non\-exempt

**WORK LOCATION:** In office, no remote work

**WORK SCHEDULE:** 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM, Monday through Friday

**STARTING PAY RANGE:** $22\.00 to $24\.00/hr (based on experience)

**Position Summary**

The HR Operations Coordinator plays an important role in supporting our employees and ensuring the smooth, efficient operation of day\-to\-day HR processes. This position is hands\-on and detail\-oriented, with responsibility for maintaining employee records and documentation, managing time\-off calendars, coordinating administrative workflows, and providing responsive employee support.

As a first point of contact, the HR Operations Coordinator will help employees navigate questions, concerns, grievances, and complaints with professionalism, discretion, and objectivity. The HR Operations Coordinator should be approachable and solutions\-oriented.

The ideal candidate is self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional who brings a positive attitude and strong communication and organizational skills to the role. The successful candidate will be comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment, able to work independently with minimal supervision, and equally effective collaborating with colleagues across the organization.

**Essential job duties and responsibilities:** 

*Employee Relations \& Initial Intake Support*

* Serve as an approachable first point of contact for employees regarding workplace concerns, policy questions, and general inquiries.
* Conduct neutral, initial intake of employee grievances, interpersonal conflicts, and formal complaints; document statements accurately and escalate promptly to executive leadership.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive employee relations matters and documentation.
* Assist leadership in preparing standard documentation for performance counseling, disciplinary notices, and separation packets.

*Time\-Off Administration \& Records*

* Receive and review manually submitted Time Off Requests (TORs).
* Print approved TORs for physical employee records and update the master company/department time\-off calendars accurately, as needed.
* Assist managers and staff with routine questions regarding time\-off availability and company leave policies.

*Onboarding, Offboarding \& Compliance Logistics*

* Assemble new hire orientation packages, coordinate pre\-employment documentation, and verify Form I\-9 compliance.
* Guide incoming staff through Day\-1 administrative onboarding and policy acknowledgments.
* Prepare standard separation paperwork, exit documentation, and coordinate the collection of company property upon employee departures.
* Assist in tracking completion rosters for annual mandatory training (e.g., Harassment Prevention).

*General HR Administration \& File Maintenance*

* Digitize, file, and organize physical and electronic personnel records, ensuring compliance with state and federal record retention laws.
* Handle general HR clerical duties, including drafting routine verification of employment letters, sorting department mail, and maintaining office forms.
* Other HR administrative tasks as assigned.

**Education and work experience:** 

* Education: Minimum high school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s degree or coursework in Human Resources, Business, or related fields preferred.
* Work experience: 1 to 3 years of hands\-on administrative or human resources experience

**Knowledge and skills:**

* High emotional intelligence, active listening skills, and an objective, professional demeanor when handling sensitive workplace concerns.
* Strong organizational skills and precision with calendar management and document tracking.
* Absolute commitment to confidentiality and ethical discretion.
* Basic familiarity with workplace policies, standard documentation practices, and labor standards.
* Working proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) or Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar).

**Physical demands:**

Primary functions require sufficient physical ability and mobility to work in an office setting, including but not limited to:

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer screen.
* Frequent typing, scanning, filing, and reading detailed paper and digital records.
* Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching to access filing cabinets.
* Ability to lift up to 20 lbs (e.g., paper reams, orientation materials, or storage boxes).

Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

**Work authorization:**

* Must be able to verify identity and employment eligibility to work in the United States.

**Benefits:** 

* Paid sick leave
* Paid time off (vacations and holidays)
* Health insurance

At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces \- we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee\-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company's long\-term success.

  


**Job Summary**



The Assistant Project Manager (APM) is a core team member responsible for managing project change orders, subcontractor coordination, and project documentation with a high level of independence and accountability. The APM understands the financial, administrative, and logistical elements of construction and supports both internal teams and client\-facing communications.

**Company:** The Jankovich Company **About The Jankovich Company**


Founded in 1933, The Jankovich Company is a family\-operated petroleum and lubricants distributor serving customers throughout Southern California. Headquartered in San Pedro, California, The Jankovich Company provides marine fueling, petroleum transportation, barge operations, bulk fuel distribution, lubricant sales, cardlock fueling services, and specialty petroleum products.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage changing priorities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across departments.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with P21, PDI, or a comparable ERP system.
* Experience working with customer, product, pricing, inventory, sales, or other business data.
* Experience in petroleum, lubricants, distribution, transportation, or a related industry.

 **Benefits**


In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: :

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents, including PPO and High\-Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) medical options, with Company contributions toward the cost of coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with Company contributions for employees enrolled in the HDHP
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options

* Employer\-paid Life and AD\&D insurance
* Employer\-paid Long\-Term Disability insurance
* Two (2\) weeks of paid vacation
* Nine (9\) paid holidays
* Six (6\) paid sick days

This is a full\-time, non\-exempt position based at our Paramount, California office. The position works primarily in an office environment and requires regular interaction with Sales, Customer Service, Operations, Accounting, and other Company personnel.


Occasional travel to other Company locations or off\-site meetings may be required.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), reproductive health decision making, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**SUMMARY**



The Los Angeles County Department of Homeless Services and Housing (HSH)consolidates our countywide response to homelessness. The driving force behind HSH is increasing accountability and transparency, improving care for people experiencing or at risk of homelessness, and streamlining collaboration with partners including services providers, the County’s 88 cities, and unincorporated areas to deliver high\-quality, life\-saving care. Staff schedules are based on business need and may include the option of a hybrid work schedule where employees work remotely and from the office.



The Homeless Prevention Unit (HPU) is a collaborative effort between HSH, California Policy Lab (CPL) and the Department of Mental Health (DMH). The HPU proactively identifies individuals who are most at risk of homelessness through predictive analytics and provides them with flexible, early interventions to resolve issues that might lead to loss of their housing. HPU is expanding to serve young adults between the ages of 18\-24 in need of proactive homelessness prevention resources. The HPU has significant interactions with several County departments to address challenges navigating service systems and/or to connect or re\-connect individuals to services to ensure housing stability; therefore, the ideal candidate will be knowledgeable in mainstream and specific programs and services tailored to young people at risk of or experiencing homelessness while being flexible to meet the changing needs and demands of the program and this population.



The Medical Case Worker II (Outreach Coordinator) position will perform full\-time proactive outreach for the HPU and will report to the Outreach Program Manager. Working closely with the TAY Case Managers and other HPU supporting staff, this position will be responsible for outreaching to and engaging with prospective clients who are identified as at high risk of experiencing homelessness. The Medical Case Worker II will conduct outreach, gather consents from prospective clients and facilitate warm hand\-offs for long\-term care to HPU Case Managers.

* Collaborates with case managers, as needed, by identifying linkages, immediate needs gathering and submitting necessary documentation from clients pre\-enrollment.

* Reviews DMH and Department of Homeless Services and Housing (HSH) medical records/databases to determine service history and contact information and coordinate with current service providers as appropriate.

* Provides HPU clients with crisis intervention support as needed including assisting clients to access emergency and crisis stabilization services such as the DMH Psychiatric Mobile Response Team (PMRT), mental health urgent care services, medical and/or substance use disorder services.
* Collaborates with HPU clients and family members (when appropriate) to develop and amend treatment plan goals.

* Collaborates and coordinates with HPU management to identify and discuss programmatic and data needs as well as obtain consultation as needed on the appropriate level of interventions/services needed to support clients.
* Other duties as assigned.

One year of experience as a Medical Case Worker I \- OR \- A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and one year of professional casework experience interviewing, counseling, and assisting patients/clients with social problems.

* A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job\-related essential functions.
* Successful clearance of the Live Scan process with the County of Los Angeles.
* Health clearance required.

jobs.description:
**Marketing Coordinator**

**Cole Services — Garden Grove, California**  
**Full\-Time \| In\-Person**  
**Salary: $55,000–$75,000 per year, based on experience, plus benefits**

**Help Us Build a 57\-Year\-Old Brand—and Drive Its Next Stage of Growth**

Most marketing coordinator positions focus on posting content, ordering promotional materials, and completing tasks assigned by someone else.

This position is different.

Cole Services is looking for a driven **Marketing Coordinator** who wants ownership, measurable goals, and the opportunity to directly influence the growth of an established home\-service company.

A major focus of this position will be growing our **Cole Comfort Club membership program** by developing campaigns that turn new and existing customers into long\-term members.

If you enjoy creating marketing campaigns, building customer loyalty, tracking results, and turning ideas into action, this may be the opportunity you have been looking for.

**Who We Are**

Cole Services is the **oldest privately held home\-service company in Orange County**. For more than 57 years, we have served Southern California homeowners with plumbing, heating, air\-conditioning, drain, sewer, and electrical services.

We were also voted a **Top Place to Work in 2025**.

We are proud of our history, but we are even more excited about our future. We believe in high standards, continuous improvement, measurable performance, excellent customer service, and creating long\-term career opportunities for our employees.

This is not a corporate position where your ideas disappear into endless meetings. You will work closely with company leadership, see the results of your work, and help shape our next stage of growth.

**What You Will Own**

**Marketing Campaigns**

* Coordinate direct\-mail, email, social\-media, referral, community, customer\-retention, and membership campaigns.
* Maintain the company’s annual marketing calendar and ensure campaigns launch on schedule.
* Help create compelling offers, advertisements, emails, social\-media content, customer communications, and promotional materials.
* Coordinate with outside marketing partners, printers, designers, photographers, and vendors.
* Protect and strengthen the Cole Services brand across every customer touchpoint.
* Help communicate what makes Cole Services different from other home\-service companies.
* Promote our history as Orange County’s oldest privately held home\-service company.
* Help showcase our recognition as a 2025 Top Place to Work.

**Cole Comfort Club Membership Growth**

* Develop and coordinate campaigns that increase Cole Comfort Club memberships.
* Market membership benefits to our existing customer database.

* Monitor membership sales by employee, department, campaign, and customer type.
* Identify opportunities to convert past customers into active members.
* Create campaigns that improve member engagement, retention, and renewal rates.
* Help develop employee contests, recognition programs, and internal communication around membership goals.
* Track cancellations and help identify ways to reduce membership loss.
* Maintain accurate membership reports and communicate progress to leadership.
* Help Cole Services build one of the strongest home\-service membership programs in Southern California.

**Marketing Performance and Reporting**

* Track leads, booked calls, new customers, membership enrollments, campaign revenue, cost per lead, and return on marketing investment.

This is a results\-based position. The Marketing Coordinator’s scorecard will include:

* New Cole Comfort Club memberships

jobs.title: Platform Support & Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
People Science is looking for a **Platform Support \& Implementation Specialist** to join our team. This is a unique opportunity to be a part of a small team who is looking to empower humanity with the tools and knowledge of science and medicine to improve ourselves, our communities, and our world by making research tools accessible and understandable.

People Science runs decentralized clinical trials, and we build the platform they run on. Chloe is our study platform: participant journeys, eCOA, data capture, and reporting for trials that happen in people's homes rather than in clinic. We operate as both a full\-service CRO and a software company, which means the people who build the product sit close to the people running the studies. We work with commercial sponsors and, increasingly, with academic medical centers and research institutions who want to run remote and hybrid studies without building the infrastructure themselves. We're a small team, venture\-backed, and growing fast.

**Job Summary**   
You are the person who makes Chloe work for the people using it, both our software clients and our own internal study teams. When a sponsor's coordinator can't figure out why a participant didn't get a scheduled assessment, you're who they ask. When a PI at an academic medical center wants to know whether their longitudinal protocol can actually be built, you're who can answer. When we ship a new feature, you're who teaches the Clinical Operations team how to use it, and you're who writes the article so nobody has to ask twice. Over time the job is less about answering questions and more about making sure the question stops getting asked.

This is a newly scoped role. You'd be the first person in it, which means real influence over how platform support works here.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**  
**Support our software clients.** Own day\-to\-day platform support for our commercial and academic software clients: sponsors, CROs, ingredient suppliers, and research institutions who license Chloe and run their own studies on it. Diagnose issues, distinguish “the platform has a bug” from “the study is configured in a way that produces this,” resolve what you can, and escalate what you can't with enough detail that engineering doesn't have to reproduce it from scratch.

**Own internal enablement.** Our Clinical Operations project managers and study builders are in Chloe every day. You'll own keeping them current: run the training when we release, build the reference material, and be the first stop for platform questions from the study teams.

**Own the knowledge base.** Take our client and internal facing documentation and make it the thing people search first and trust. Write it, keep it current as the product changes, and measure whether it's reducing inbound volume.

**Support new client onboarding.** Help get new software clients configured, trained, and live, working alongside product and Clinical Operations. Ideally you can take an academic implementation and own it yourself: translate the protocol into a working configuration, run UAT, get the team to go\-live, and stay available through the early weeks of enrollment, when the real questions surface.

**Reduce your own queue.** A real expectation, not a flourish. We want you to notice the ticket you've now answered nine times and go fix the underlying thing: a confusing label, a missing default, a documentation gap, a workflow that needs a product change. You'll bring those to product with a recommendation attached.

**What We Are Looking For**  
We care much more about how you think than about your exact title history. A research coordinator who has built complex study instruments and is genuinely good with software will do better here than a career support rep who has never seen a protocol.

**Required**

* 3\+ years in clinical research operations, including time in academic or institutional research: research coordinator, research program manager, clinical research informatics, CRC, CRA, clinical data, or site management at a university, academic medical center, research institute, CRO, or sponsor. You know what an IRB submission involves and why a coordinator's week looks the way it does.
* Hands\-on experience building study instruments in an EDC, REDCap in particular: designing projects, longitudinal designs, branching logic, surveys, data dictionaries, exports. If you're the person your department comes to with REDCap problems, we want to talk to you.
* Strong protocol literacy. You can read a protocol and identify the operational and technical problems in it before anyone builds anything.
* Experience supporting people outside your own team: external clients, study sites, investigators, or vendors. You can hold a room with a PI who is skeptical and short on time.
* Real comfort with software as a system, not just as a user. You've been the person on your team who figured out the tool everyone else avoided.
* Clear, direct written communication. Much of this job is writing: tickets, articles, explanations.
* Genuinely self\-directed. The most important trait for this role. When you hit something you don't know, your instinct is to dig into the protocol, the configuration, and the documentation and come back with “here's what I think is happening and here's what I'd do,” not “what should I do?”
* Fluent with AI tools in your actual daily work. This is a requirement, not a perk. A meaningful part of this job, including knowledge base content, first\-draft responses, mapping a REDCap data dictionary onto a Chloe configuration, pulling data out of analytics tools, and summarizing what changed in a release, gets dramatically faster if you're good with AI tools, and we've scoped the role assuming you are. We're looking for someone who already reaches for these tools without being told to, and who has developed judgment about where they help and where they produce confident nonsense. In a regulated clinical context, knowing when *not

jobs.description:
#### **About this Position**

At Henkel, you’ll be part of an organization that’s shaping the future through innovation, sustainability and collaboration. With our trusted brands like Persil®, ‘all®, Loctite®, Snuggle®, and Schwarzkopf® and our cutting\-edge technologies, you’ll have countless opportunities to explore new paths and grow.
  

  

This position is with our Adhesive Technologies business unit – where we empower our people to transform industries and provide our customers with a competitive advantage through adhesives, sealants and functional coatings.
  

  

Dare to learn new skills, advance in your career and make an impact at Henkel.  

  

#### **What you´ll do**

* Generate and qualify leads for subsequent development. This includes providing technical presentations to structural engineering firms, conducting face to face meetings, and attending industry meetings and conferences.
* Manage the business development effort. With the support of management, define and execute sales strategies and tactics to meet or exceed annual sales plans and quotas.
* Collaborate with internal engineering team and external clients to develop innovative strengthening and repair solutions.
* Perform key account planning to identify, develop, and close business opportunities in support of business plan and strategic objectives. Maintain favorable business relationships with key accounts (structural engineers, general contractors and certified applicators).
* Cultivate a comprehensive understanding of the technical solutions offered by Fyfe’s Tyfo products and services. Conduct sales calls and make product / service presentations to meet customer needs.
* Review and understand bid documents on opportunities pursued in territory. Provide input into the design process, optimize pricing, and develop relationships to acquire and execute profitable orders.
* Fully utilize company CRM (SalesForce) to provide accurate forecasting and resource allocation.
* Generate market and competitor intelligence and perform market analysis to drive territory sales growth.
* Develop technical specifications that support product position, proper bidding requirements and ensures successful project completion.
* Spearhead management of customer service and achieve customer satisfaction. Ensure prompt investigation of client concerns and provide problem resolutions or referral to appropriate personnel.
* Remain current on sales performance and provide sales reports as required. Provide ongoing status reports to detail activity to include factored sales forecast, orders report, and backlog report.


#### **What makes you a good fit**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Civil or Structural Engineering, PE accreditation highly desirable.
* 3\+ years’ experience as a Consulting Engineer in structural engineering environment.
* A genuine interest in learning to sell and serving clients. Competitive and achievement oriented. Self\-motivated and a self\-starter.
* Trainable \& coachable in professional selling techniques.
* Client focused and strong structural engineering background.
* Ability to work with presentation software.
* Microsoft Office skills (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint) required.
* Ability to travel up to 50% by automobile and airplane required.

#### **Some benefits of joining Henkel**

* Health Insurance: affordable plans for medical, dental, vision and wellbeing starting on day 1
* Work\-Life Balance: Paid time off including sick, vacation, holiday and volunteer time, flexible \& hybrid work policies (depending on role), and vacation buy / sell program
* Financial: 401k matching, employee share plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares, annual performance bonus, service awards and student loan reimbursement
* Family Support: 12\-week gender neutral parental leave (up to 20 weeks for parents giving birth), fertility support, adoption \& surrogacy reimbursement, discounted child and elderly care, and scholarships
* Career Growth: diverse national and international growth opportunities, access to thousands of skills development courses, and tuition reimbursement


The salary range for this role is $120,000\.00 and $155,000\.00\. This range represents the good‑faith minimum and maximum wages the Company reasonably expects to offer for this role at the time of posting. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for incentive pay or other forms of compensation, as applicable. The Company also offers a comprehensive benefits package as described above. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, experience, education, training, and work location. jobs.title: TikTok Shop Account Manager - Los Angeles
jobs.description:
### **About Spotlight Media**


Spotlight Media is a leading TikTok Shop Partner agency, scaling some of the most recognizable brands in the new age of social commerce. Unlike traditional agencies, we don’t believe in cookie\-cutter playbooks—every strategy we craft is custom\-built to unlock our clients’ full potential on TikTok Shop. As a TikTok Shop–only agency, our entire focus, from the initiatives we pursue to the talent we hire, is singularly dedicated to driving growth on the platform.


We’ve guided brands through the full funnel\- from launch to scaling into the millions in GMV\-and we’re just getting started.


We believe the future of e\-commerce is social. That’s why we’re building a team of high\-agency individuals who thrive on ownership, autonomy, and speed. Spotlight is not just a place to execute campaigns—it’s a blank canvas where ambitious people can build real leverage, take on increasing responsibility, and grow into senior operators quickly. Our culture is high\-performing, entrepreneurial, and unapologetically ambitious.


Join us, and you’ll have the trust, resources, and runway to redefine what’s possible for the world’s leading brands.

  

### **Role Overview**


We're looking for an **Account Manager** **based in Los Angeles**. This will be a **remote role** but due to our client needs you need to be based in Los Angeles.
  

  

You’ll be the execution engine for TikTok Shop accounts, working directly under a Senior Account Manager. You’ll help translate strategy into action, keep projects moving, maintain shop health, and deliver consistent, high\-quality execution across teams.


This is a **learn\-by\-doing role** designed for high\-agency operators who want to grow fast. Early on, you’ll focus on execution and account operations. As you demonstrate judgment, reliability, and ownership, your scope will expand into growth initiatives, client leadership, and strategy\-**with a clear path to Senior Account Manager typically within 6–12 months** for strong performers.

  

### **What You’ll Do**


Client Operations \& Communication

* Run the account operating rhythm: prep agendas, take notes, track action items, and send crisp recaps for WBRs/MBRs/QBRs.
* Build and maintain 30\-60\-90 day plans for each client; update owners, timelines, and success metrics weekly.
* Draft client updates and deck slides; translate performance data into clear narratives and concrete next steps.
* Manage tickets and issues, chase dependencies, and keep all stakeholders aligned and on timeline.


TikTok Shop Execution \& Health

* Own day\-to\-day Seller Center hygiene: PDP checks (titles, attributes, images), catalog updates, and compliance follow\-ups.
* Monitor and report account\-health metrics (e.g., Late Dispatch Rate, Valid Tracking Rate, cancellations/refunds) and flag risks early.
* Launch and coordinate promotions (bundles, coupons, seasonal events) with Content and Media teams.
* Support troubleshooting for approvals or policy issues by organizing evidence, timelines, and escalation documentation.


Cross\-Functional Orchestration (No Content Creation)

* Write airtight briefs for Content and Creative teams; track revisions against SLAs and quality bars.
* Partner with Media and Analytics on dashboards, UTM hygiene, and weekly performance readouts (GMV, CTR, CVR, AOV, refunds).
* Coordinate with Ops and Logistics on fulfillment readiness and customer experience status.


Data, QA, and Process

* Maintain source\-of\-truth documentation in Notion: trackers, risk logs, promo calendars, and asset libraries.
* Perform QA checks before delivery (accuracy, links, pricing, promo eligibility, compliance).
* Contribute to and improve playbooks and SOPs; capture lessons learned in retros to help the team move faster over time.

### **What You’ll Learn \& Growth Trajectory**

* Shadow your Senior AM on strategy development, escalations, negotiations, and QBR storytelling.
* Gradually take point on client calls, scope changes, and mini\-initiatives (e.g., a seasonal promo or creator activation).
* Expand from execution ownership strategy as you consistently hit scorecard targets.
* **Clear, merit\-based path to Senior Account Manager**, with increasing responsibility, influence, and compensation as your scope grows.

### **Success Metrics**

* **Delivery reliability:** On\-time/on\-brief execution; rework rate trending down.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:

**Luminate Data** is looking for a **Revenue Operations Manager** to bring order, insight, and speed to how our go\-to\-market teams work. You'll own the systems, data, and processes that connect Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, making sure the revenue engine runs on clean data, sound process, and reliable reporting. This is an individual\-contributor role for someone who's energized by solving operational problems and translating messy reality into scalable systems.


**What You'll Do**


**Systems \& AI/Automation (\~30% of role)**


* Own and administer our GTM tech stack (Salesforce, ChurnZero, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Salesloft, Clay, and ZoomInfo) supporting the full sales org's configuration, data hygiene, workflows, and integrations
* Identify and implement at least 3–4 AI/automation initiatives per year that measurably cut manual work (e.g., deal qualification, data entry, routine reporting) by 20%\+ in affected workflows
* Maintain CRM data quality at a 95%\+ accuracy/completeness standard through recurring audits, deduplication, and enrichment
* Manage the GTM systems roadmap by evaluating, piloting, and rolling out new capabilities as the team scales


**Analytics \& Reporting (\~30% of role)**


* Build and maintain dashboards and reports that give leadership a clear, accurate, real\-time view of pipeline, forecast, and revenue performance
* Turn large, messy data sets into clear, actionable insights that shape GTM strategy and decision\-making
* Run monthly and quarterly reporting cycles, including pipeline reviews and board\-level metrics
* Present findings, recommendations, and performance updates to groups including executive leadership


**Process \& Cross\-Functional Partnership (\~25% of role)**


* Design and document processes for lead routing, opportunity management, quoting, and the deal desk
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success leaders to identify bottlenecks and implement fixes that improve funnel conversion and rep productivity


**Planning Support (\~15% of role)**


* Co\-lead the annual operating plan (AOP) process, partnering with Finance and Sales leadership to build revenue targets, growth drivers, headcount assumptions, and capacity models
* Support territory planning, quota setting, and sales compensation calculations
* Maintain rep\-level quota and territory documentation, updating it as the org and market evolve


 **What We're Looking For**


* At least 3–5 years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or a related analytics/systems role, ideally at a B2B SaaS or data company
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce and tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ChurnZero, Salesloft, Clay, and ZoomInfo
* Strong Excel/Sheets skills, with a genuinely analytical mindset. Comfortable taking large data sets and distilling them into clear, actionable insights
* Comfortable using AI tools and automation to improve process efficiency, not just doing things the old way
* Confident presenting to groups, including executives, and translating data into a clear narrative for non\-technical audiences
* A track record of building or improving processes in a fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environment
* A bias toward action and ownership; comfortable working independently with minimal oversight


**Nice to Have**


* Experience at an early\- or growth\-stage startup
* Experience in the Music or Film and TV industries
* Exposure to sales compensation design or deal desk processes

  


**As Luminate values in\-person collaboration and team cohesion, employees work onsite 4 days a week and 1 day remotely with a focus on maintaining a vibrant and inclusive culture.**



Additionally, applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.


**For candidates based in California:** A good faith estimate of the salary range is $110k\-$125k \+ commission upon hire. We consider your skills and experience, what similar jobs pay at companies of our size, and ensure fair pay among colleagues. Final base salary offer amounts are determined by factors including your experience and expertise. In addition we are proud to offer additional perks and benefits that contribute and complete our total compensation package. Luminate reserves the right to change our compensation bands at any time.

 **It's all About You…**



As a part of PMC's family of companies, Luminate's comprehensive benefits package is thoughtfully designed to support every aspect of your life, empowering you to thrive both personally and professionally. **We offer Company\-Paid Healthcare Premiums with no employee paycheck contributions on medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family.** Luminate also offers Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care \& Commuter), an Employee Assistance Program, Life Insurance, Short \& Long Term Disability, Paid Parental Leave, and a 401(k) Retirement Plan with an Employer match. Employees are also eligible to take advantage of company discounts and perks including Pet Insurance, Home \& Auto Insurance, Mortgage discounts, and a variety of other savings on wellness, lifestyle, and financial essentials. **As part of Luminate dedication to consistently meet employee's needs, we maintain a Flexible Vacation Policy.**

jobs.title: Manager, Digital Marketing (YouTube – Kids & Family)

* **Please note** – this is a project hire role with an estimated duration of one year. If you’re an internal employee, please discuss further with recruiter.

**Job Summary**
===============


The Kids \& Family Marketing team drives the campaigns, creative, and content that connect our kids' and family entertainment brands with audiences across every platform \- with YouTube as one key platform. The Manager, Digital Marketing is a hybrid “left\-brain \& right\-brain” role: part creative partner, part producer. This person will be pulled into concepting and creative ideation sessions as a genuine creative contributor, and will also own the end\-to\-end production, tracking, delivery, and performance of that creative \- ensuring assets are produced on time, on brand, and ready for distribution.


This role works hand\-in\-hand with our Marketing team as well as our Programming Strategy team, who own scheduling, publishing, and channel operations for Disney Entertainment Television's “made for kids” YouTube channels. Marketing creates it; Programming distributes it and this person is the connective tissue between the two, making sure creative is conceived with platform and audience in mind, produced efficiently, and handed off with everything Programming needs to publish and optimize it successfully.

**Responsibilities**
====================

**Creative Concepting \& Ideation**

* Partner with Marketing, Creative, and Brand leads as an active creative contributor in concepting sessions for YouTube\-distributed campaigns.
* Generate endemic YouTube Made for Kids creative across numerous Disney Kids brands, characters, IP and more.
* Translate broader marketing creative to ideas tailored specifically for YouTube's format, audience behavior, and “made for kids” requirements.
* Champion strong creative output and craft, holding concepts and cuts to a high bar even under fast turnaround timelines.

**Production Management \& Tracking**

* Own end\-to\-end production timelines for marketing creative destined for YouTube from brief through internal reviews, revisions, approvals, and final delivery.
* Track status of all in\-flight creative assets across editors, designers, and outside vendors; proactively flag risks to deadlines or quality.
* Manage budgets, scopes, and vendor or freelancer relationships for creative production as needed.
* Maintain organized, up\-to\-date asset trackers, briefs, and delivery specs so nothing falls through the cracks between Marketing and Programming.

**Partnership with Programming Strategy**

* Serve as a marketing point of contact for the Programming Strategist(s) who manage day\-to\-day publishing on Disney's made\-for\-kids YouTube channels.
* Ensure creative assets are delivered to Programming in the correct formats, aspect ratios, and metadata\-ready state for full episodes, shorts, compilations, and livestream promotion.
* Align on release windows, tentpole moments, and campaign cadences so marketing creative and channel publishing schedules are fully in sync.
* Work with stakeholders early during concepting so creative is designed with platform best practices, algorithm behavior, and channel strategy.

**Performance \& Creative Optimization**

* Partner with Programming and Research teams to monitor how marketing creative performs once live \- views, CTR, retention, and engagement.
* Apply and communicate performance learnings back into creative development: refining hooks, thumbnails, pacing, and packaging for future campaigns.
* Support A/B testing of creative variants (thumbnails, titles, cutdowns) in partnership with Programming's channel operations.
* Stay current on YouTube trends, kids' content and fandom culture, and emerging formats (Shorts, livestreams) to keep creative fresh and competitive.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as a bridge across Marketing, Creative Services, Programming, Production, and Research teams to keep campaigns and YT creative moving smoothly.

**Basic Qualifications**
========================

* 5\+ years of experience in a role that blended creative development with project or production management, ideally within YouTube channel management, marketing, entertainment, or digital/social content.
* Demonstrated ability to contribute real creative ideas \- not just execute a brief with a strong sense of what makes content work on YouTube specifically.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent productions or campaigns with competing deadlines, budgets, stakeholders and vendors.
* Working knowledge of YouTube as a platform: content formats, thumbnail/title best practices, Shorts, and audience behavior, especially within kids' and family content.
* Comfort partnering with editors, designers, and outside vendors to shepherd creative from concept to final delivery.
* Highly organized with meticulous attention to detail and strong follow\-through on tracking and delivery.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to move fluidly between creative conversations and operational status updates.

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, film/media, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. jobs.title: Inside Sales - Used Equipment
jobs.description:
California, Nevada and Idaho. Coastline provides world\-class equipment solutions from John Deere, Wirtgen and Topcon. At their 13 locations, Coastline delivers best\-in\-class equipment, parts, service and technology solutions for customers. Our team of experts is driven to meet the needs of our customers both where they are today and where they are going tomorrow.


The team at Coastline is looking to hire an **Inside****S****ales – Used Equipment** representative.

**Position Overview:**


The Out of Territory Used Equipment Sales Representative is responsible for maximizing the sale of Coastline Equipment's used and aged rental fleet equipment outside of Coastline Equipment's assigned John Deere Area of Responsibility (AOR). This position develops relationships with equipment dealers, brokers, contractors, wholesalers, exporters, and end users throughout North America and Internationally to efficiently market and sell used assets while maintaining market value.


In addition to equipment sales, this position will assist the UEM in identifying and sourcing quality used equipment acquisition opportunities that support Coastline Equipment's in\-territory retail sales efforts. The representative will work closely with the Used Equipment Manager to help optimize inventory levels and support overall dealership profitability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Used Equipment Sales**: Market, promote, and sell used and aged rental fleet equipment to customers outside of Coastline Equipment’s assigned territory.
* **Business Development**: Develop and maintain relationships with equipment dealers, brokers, wholesalers, exporters, rental companies, contractors, and end users to expand sales and sourcing opportunities.
* **Sales Process Management**: Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, quotations, negotiations, financing coordination, delivery logistics, and post\-sale customer support.
* **Equipment Acquisition \& Inventory Management**: Source quality used equipment from outside Coastline’s territory, evaluate acquisition opportunities, and support inventory needs across California, Nevada, and Idaho.
* **Equipment Evaluation**: Assess equipment condition, specifications, maintenance history, market value, and profitability to support purchasing and sales decisions.
* **Market Analysis**: Monitor auction results, wholesale trends, market conditions, dealer inventories, and competitive activity to establish equipment values and identify opportunities.
* **Logistics Coordination**: Coordinate equipment inspections, appraisals, repairs, transportation, and acquisition logistics to ensure timely and efficient transactions.
* **CRM \& Reporting**: Maintain accurate CRM records, customer activity, inventory data, sales pipeline information, and prepare regular sales and market reports.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Partner with Territory Sales Representatives and internal departments to support customer opportunities, inventory objectives, and territory alignment.
* **Industry Representation \& Compliance**: Represent Coastline Equipment at auctions, trade shows, dealer meetings, and industry events while ensuring compliance with dealership policies, John Deere requirements, and applicable regulations.

**Required Qualifications:**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or equivalent.
* **Sales Experience:** Minimum 3–5 years of equipment sales, territory sales, or related industry experience.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Strong knowledge of construction, compact equipment, rental, or heavy equipment markets.
* **Used Equipment Expertise:** Understanding of used equipment valuation, depreciation, market trends, and equipment purchasing/sales processes.
* **Negotiation Skills:** Excellent negotiation, closing, and customer relationship management abilities.
* **Communication Skills:** Strong verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* **Customer Focus:** Ability to develop and maintain long\-term customer relationships through a professional and customer\-focused approach.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency with CRM software and Microsoft Office applications.
* **Organization \& Time Management:** Ability to prioritize multiple projects, manage deadlines, and work independently with minimal supervision.
* **Financing \& Documentation:** Understanding of equipment financing options, sales documentation, and related transactional processes.
* **Work Environment:** Ability to work from a full\-service Coastline Equipment location.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Industry Experience:** Experience within the agricultural, construction, rental, or heavy equipment industries.
* **John Deere Knowledge:** Knowledge of John Deere equipment, products, and competitive manufacturers.
* **Used Equipment Sales \& Purchasing:** Experience sourcing, buying, and selling used equipment.

**Physical Requirements:**

* **Physical Conditions:** Must be able to lift 15 pounds.

**What We Offer:**

* **Salary:** $29\.00\-$39\.00 per hour year plus commission
* **Health and Wellness Benefits:** Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
* **Retirement Plans:** 401(k) plans with company matching contributions.
* **Paid Time Off:** Vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays.

* To apply, please submit your resume and application detailing your relevant experience and why you're interested in this position. We look forward to hearing from you! To learn more and keep up with Coastline Equipment, visit our website, https://www.coastlineequipment.com/.

**Deadline:** Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Representative / Physician Liaison – Fertility Clinic
jobs.description:
**About Us**

We are a leading assisted reproductive technology (ART) fertility clinic located in Torrance, CA, dedicated to helping individuals and couples build their families. We provide world\-class fertility care including IVF, egg freezing, genetic testing, and comprehensive reproductive health services. We are currently seeking a motivated, relationship\-driven Field Marketing Representative to join our team and expand our referral network with OB/GYN clinics, women‘s health providers, and community healthcare partners in the Greater Los Angeles area.

**Position Overview**

This is a front\-line, field\-based role. You will be the “face” of our clinic to referring OB/GYN practices, primary care physicians, and other healthcare providers. Your primary mission is to build and nurture strong referral relationships, educate community physicians about our services and success rates, and drive patient referrals to our clinic. This role requires frequent in\-person visits to OB/GYN clinics and medical offices throughout the Torrance and surrounding South Bay / LA area.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct regular in\-person visits to OB/GYN clinics, women’s health practices, and primary care offices in your assigned territory
* Build and maintain strong, trusting relationships with physicians, nurse practitioners, and medical office staff
* Educate referring providers on our fertility services, treatment options, success rates, and referral pathways
* Distribute promotional materials and keep referring offices updated on new services, physician availability, and clinic events
* Identify and develop new referral sources, including community health organizations, advocacy groups, and corporate wellness programs
* Represent the clinic at community events, health fairs, and medical conferences
* Track all partner interactions, referral volumes, and outreach activities in CRM system
* Gather market intelligence on competitor activities and physician needs, and provide feedback to the marketing and clinical teams
* Coordinate and host lunch\-and\-learns, educational presentations, and open\-house events for medical professionals

**Qualifications**

* Associate’s or Bachelor‘s degree in Marketing, Business, Healthcare Administration, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 1–3 years of experience in field sales, medical sales, pharmaceutical sales, or healthcare business development preferred
* Experience in fertility, OB/GYN, women’s health, or reproductive medicine is a strong plus
* Existing relationships with OB/GYN practices or physicians in the South Bay / Los Angeles area is highly desirable
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Self\-motivated with strong time management skills and ability to work independently in the field
* Comfortable with cold outreach and building relationships from the ground up
* Valid driver‘s license and reliable transportation (mileage reimbursement provided)
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM software
* Bilingual (English/Spanish or English/Mandarin/Cantonese) is a plus, but not required

Pay: From $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Disability insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Travel reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing and Communications Officer, the Executive Assistant provides executive support and organization to the Marketing and Communications Department. The Executive Assistant organizes and coordinates executive outreach and internal and external relations efforts; and oversees unique assignments.



The Executive Assistant must be organized, creative, and enjoy working within an entrepreneurial environment that is mission\-driven, results\-driven, and community\-oriented. The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment in a variety of situations, with strong written and verbal communication, administrative, and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain a realistic balance among multiple and possibly changing priorities. The Executive Assistant will have the ability to work independently on projects, from conception to completion, and must be able to work under pressure at times to handle a wide variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.


**Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Manages a wide range of administrative functions, including, but not limited to: calendar management, expense reporting, travel arrangements, correspondence, meeting preparation, office supply procurement, mail distribution, organizing filing systems, managing special projects and guest coordination.

* Keeps the Chief Marketing and Communications Officer informed of upcoming commitments, responsibilities, and emerging issues, following up as needed.
* Researches, prioritizes, and responds to sensitive and confidential matters, determining appropriate action, referrals, or responses.
* Conducts research and prepares, edits, and coordinates executive communications, presentations, correspondence, and meeting materials.
* Manages competing priorities with sound judgment, proactively resolving issues and ensuring timely completion of assignments, often under tight deadlines.
* Serves as a liaison between the Chief Marketing and Communications Officer, internal departments, Board Committees, and external stakeholders, fostering effective communication and ensuring timely approvals and follow\-through.

* Very strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders, including staff, board members, vendors, external partners, and donors.

* Demonstrated proactive approaches to problem\-solving with strong decision\-making capability.
* Emotional maturity and ability to handle ambiguity and change.
* Self\-starter and highly resourceful team player, with the ability to also be extremely effective independently.
* Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion, be adaptable to various competing demands, and demonstrate the highest level of customer/client service and response.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve high performance goals and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

* Minimum three (3\) years administrative assistant or related experience

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Join our dynamic property management team as an Assistant Community Manager for a senior community in Monrovia! In this energetic role, you will be the vital link between residents, vendors, and property operations, ensuring a vibrant, well\-maintained community. Your proactive approach and excellent communication skills will help foster a welcoming environment while managing administrative tasks with precision. You’ll play a key role in maintaining compliance with fair housing regulations and enhancing resident satisfaction through exceptional service.

The schedule for this position is Tuesdays\-Saturdays with Sundays and Mondays as "off" days.

**Responsibilities**

* Assist in managing lease or rental agreement processes, including application screening, lease signing, and renewals using Yardi Voyager property management.
* Coordinate property maintenance requests and facilities management to ensure a safe and attractive environment for residents.
* Maintain accurate data entry, filing, and record\-keeping related to tenant files, contracts, and compliance documentation such as Bond and Section 8 programs.
* Handle client communication with professionalism via phone, email, and in person to address inquiries promptly and courteously.
* Enforce fair housing laws and Section 8 regulations diligently while managing conflict resolution among residents or staff.
* Assist with community resident events, such as pot lucks, holiday parties, etc.
* Complete tenant move\-in/move\-out inspections in compliance with all company procedures.
* Daily reports / Conduct unit inspections.
* Maintain the safety and security of the apartment community and its residents at all times.
* Other duties as assigned by supervisor(s).

**Experience**

* Proven experience in property management or real estate administrative roles with hands\-on knowledge using Yardi Voyager.
* Strong understanding of landlord\-tenant law, fair housing regulations, and Bond and Section 8 compliance requirements.
* Prior experience managing lease agreements, rental contracts, or tenant relations within a property management company setting.
* Demonstrated ability to handle conflict management professionally while maintaining excellent customer service standards.
* Office experience involving data entry, filing systems, customer relationship management (CRM), and administrative support functions.
* Knowledge of property maintenance procedures and facilities management practices is highly desirable.
* Excellent negotiation skills combined with effective phone etiquette and client communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities efficiently in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.

Embark on this rewarding journey where your skills will make a tangible difference in residents’ lives while advancing your career in property management!

We maintain a Smoke Free workplace and we are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Assistant Account Manager, Commercial Lines
jobs.description:
**ABOUT HUB:**


In a rapidly changing world, HUB advises businesses and individuals on how to prepare for the unexpected. As one of the worlds' largest insurance brokers, our focus is dedicated to providing our customers with the peace of mind that what matters most will be protected\-through unrelenting advocacy and tailored insurance solutions that put our clients in control. Our growing team of professionals across North America represents a broad, deep and one\-of \-a kind aggregation of entrepreneurs and leaders recognized for their excellence throughout the insurance community.

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**


The Assistant Account Manager provides a high level of support in obtaining, maintaining, expanding, and servicing commercial lines accounts. This position assists with certificates of insurance, policy changes, gathering renewal information preparing client presentations, general account assistance and other special projects. This position will require meeting daily production standards, goals and service commitments.

**DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assists the Account Management team with all aspects of the account\-service process.
* Responds to policy inquiries via phone and email. May field phone calls from insureds regarding questions about their coverage, changes, additions, payments, cancellations etc.
* Responsible for service work as needed on a daily basis. Including but not limited to the following: certificates of insurance, policy changes and client payments.
* Participates in the renewal preparation process, including generating renewal updates on accounts.
* Assists with marketing clients to carriers.
* Assists with coordinating premium financing and the collection of premiums.
* Checks policies/endorsements and audits for accuracy.
* Prepares quotes and proposals.
* Provides professional, courteous service to our clients, carrier representatives, underwriters, business partners, and HUB colleagues, resulting in a rate of account retention that meets or exceeds expectations.
* Maintains accurate and organized account files by appropriately documenting conversations with clients and carrier representatives; updates all HUB computer systems and automated agency management systems; ensures the accuracy of data
* Performs other duties and projects as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High School / GED
* 1\-2 years insurance industry experience or equivalent combination of education \& experience
* Property \& Causality License required within first 6 months
* Experience in Medical Malpractice Insurance a plus

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages.
* Ability to effectively and professionally communicate orally and in writing with internal and external customers.
* Ability to efficiently gather pertinent information and facts, analyze and solve problems timely and thoroughly.
* Ability to prioritize and organize multiple tasks and responsibilities in order to complete assignments on time and with optimal accuracy.
* Ability to respond to customer needs, solicit customer feedback to improve service, and handle difficult or emotional customer situations promptly and accurately.
* Computer skills: proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Outlook.
* Critical Thinking: Ability to use logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.
* Desire to learn and grow within the insurance industry.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* This position primarily involves remaining in a stationary position for the majority of the workday.
* The person in this position frequently communicates with colleagues and clients both in person and on the telephone; Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information.
* Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
* The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

**WHY CHOOSE HUB?**


Throughout our network of more than 450 HUB offices in North America, we offer a competitive, exciting and friendly work environment that strategically positions our employees for longevity and success. At HUB, we believe in investing in the future of our employees, and provide continuous opportunities for growth and development*.* Our entrepreneurial culture fosters an environment that empowers our people to make the best decisions for our customers and organization, focusing on expanding the industry knowledge of our insurance professionals to better serve our valued clients. We are committed to providing you with competitive and flexible benefits options that are rooted in your current needs, yet evolves as your needs change over time. Join us in taking the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction.

At Henkel, you’ll be part of an organization that’s shaping the future through innovation, sustainability and collaboration. With our trusted brands like Persil®, ‘all®, Loctite®, Snuggle®, and Schwarzkopf® and our cutting\-edge technologies, you’ll have countless opportunities to explore new paths and grow.
  

  

This position is with our Adhesive Technologies business unit – where we empower our people to transform industries and provide our customers with a competitive advantage through adhesives, sealants and functional coatings.
  

  

Dare to learn new skills, advance in your career and make an impact at Henkel.

* A genuine interest in learning to sell and serving clients. Competitive and achievement oriented. Self\-motivated and a self\-starter.
