* Client focused and strong structural engineering background.

jobs.description:
**INNOCEAN USA**, a full\-service advertising agency located in Huntington Beach, CA, is searching for a **Data Account Manager** to join our growing **Genesis** team!


**This is contract role through the end of 2026 with potential to be extended into 2027\.**

**We are a hybrid work environment, x3 days week in\-office. Candidates must be local to SoCal.**




**OVERVIEW:**

**The Data Account Manager is responsible for the day\-to\-day management of the client’s automotive data infrastructure and identity resolution initiatives, website campaigns, and ensuring that the agency delivers quality work on time and within budget.**

This role needs to have experience in a (digital) agency or client services environment. **The successful candidate should possess strong client management skills including, but not limited to, leading presentations, trouble\-shooting problems, and critical thinking.** They should be solutions oriented and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining excellent organization and poise.


**The candidate should have working\-knowledge of identity resolution, data security principles and customer data management. The ideal candidate will also have experience running RFI / RFPs and is familiar with corporate procurments processes.**

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Work with the client daily to identify needs and expectations
* Provide frequent and detailed updates to Account leadership to flag potential issues and proactively problem solve.
* Work closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering to access and define timelines, goals, and manage progress.
* Identify key stakeholders and disseminate information as necessary
* Present/communicate progress and outcome of projects to clients and determine best next steps
* Facilitate internal and client reviews, update status documents, legal routing, contact reports, and meeting coordination
* Show solid knowledge of the client’s business (including pricing, product, sales, marketing channels, strategies, and competitive landscape)
* Oversee the efforts of junior staff

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **6\-8 years of experience in a client services function within a Digital Marketing, Advertising or Business\-related field.**
* **Must have working\-knowledge of identity resolution, data security principles and customer data management.**
* Knowledgeable in MS software, Word, Power Point, and Excel
* Strong presentation and communication skill
* Strong project management skills and ability to develop and implement new processes
* Ability to stay organized and manage multiple projects efficiently
* Motivated team player
* Ability to assess a situation and make sound judgment calls / recommendations
* Foster positive relationships with clients, external partners, and internal teams
* Know how to wear many “hats”




**BENEFITS:**

* Access to our health benefits
* Paid sick days
* 401k match
* On\-site Barista
* Beautiful campus across from the Pacific Ocean




The salary range for this role is $100,000 \- $120,000\. Pay is dependent upon several factors including but not limited to: client, experience, training and/or transferable skills.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Meet Vestis®:** For the People Who Make It All Work
  
At Vestis®, we provide uniforms, workplace supplies, and professional cleaning that help businesses simplify their workday and keep their teams safe, confident, and focused on what matters most. More than a provider, we are a partner in productivity, trusted to keep you running.
  
Join us and build a career supporting the people who make it all work.
  
  

**Job Overview:**  

The Account Manager (AM) focuses on identifying and developing new product opportunities within the existing customer base. This role involves prospecting, presenting programs, and meeting sales quotas.
  
  

**Responsibilities/Essential Functions:**  

* The AM is expected to penetrate the current customer base and generate revenue through additional category adds – Uniforms, Workplace Supplies, Managed Restroom Services, First Aid and Direct Sales.
* The AM will also focus on securing contract renewals.
* Key responsibilities include documenting customer information, maintaining sales reports, and communicating product details to the service department.
* The AM is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with customers to drive sales and identify new opportunities.
* Drive a systematic sampling program that leads to proposal generation.
* As a direct report to the Sales Manager, this position will collaborate with the Sales and Operations teams to sell into the current customer base.


**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**  

* Must be customer oriented and able to communicate effectively
* Ability to provide a high quality service within a fast\-paced and physically challenging environment
* Goal driven and self\-motivated to include problem solving skills
* Knowledgeable in Microsoft Office applications (including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Internet/Intranet)


**Experience/Qualifications:**  

* High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s/Associates Degree preferred
* Prior experience in Route Sales and/or Business to Business (B2B) sales preferred


**License Requirements/Certifications:**  

* Valid Driver's License required


**Working Environment/Safety Requirements/Physical Requirements:**
  
Safely lift and carry up to 30 lbs consistently
  
  

Headquartered in Roswell, GA, Vestis® is the second largest provider in the industry with over 300,000 customer locations and approximately 20,000 teammates across North America. Vestis® is a leader in the B2B uniform and workplace supplies category. Vestis® provides clean and safe uniform services and workplace supplies to a broad range of North American customers from Fortune 500 companies to locally owned small businesses across a broad set of end markets. The Company’s comprehensive service offering includes a full\-service uniform rental program, cleanroom and other specialty garment processing, floor mats, towels, linens, managed restroom services, first aid supplies and more.

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
***About Us***


Headquartered in the United States, TP\-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi\-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP\-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.


We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP\-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high\-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.


Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.


The **Influencer Marketing Specialist** will play a key role in scaling TP\-Link's influencer program into a high\-performing customer acquisition channel. This individual will be responsible for identifying, recruiting, negotiating, and managing relationships with content creators across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, building a robust and diverse network of influencers who align with TP\-Link's brand and product portfolio. Working across categories such as networking technology, smart home solutions, gaming, and productivity, the role will focus on developing scalable creator partnerships that drive awareness, engagement, and measurable business results.


The ideal candidate combines strong relationship\-building and negotiation skills with a data\-driven approach to marketing performance. They will oversee campaign execution from creator outreach and product seeding through content launch and performance analysis, tracking key metrics such as views, engagement, clicks, promo code usage, and sales attribution. Partnering closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Paid Media, and Channel teams, this individual will help align influencer content with product launches and strategic initiatives while continuously optimizing recruitment processes, compensation models, and campaign performance. This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organized marketing professional who is passionate about creator partnerships, consumer technology, and building influencer programs at scale.

 **Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years in influencer marketing or creator partnerships, ideally in tech or consumer electronics.
* Proven experience sourcing, negotiating, and contracting creators across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience tracking video metrics and conversion performance (clicks, promo codes, sales attribution).
* Excellent negotiation, relationship management, and communication skills.
* Familiarity with FTC disclosure guidelines and standard influencer contract terms.
* Highly organized, able to manage multiple campaigns and creator relationships at once.  

Passion for consumer tech, networking, or smart home products is a plus.

  

  

**Benefits**  

Salary Range: $70,304 \- $130,000

* Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial coverage for dependents)
* Contributions to 401k funds
* 15 days accrued vacation
* 11 paid holidays
* Bi\-annual pay increases
* Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
* Quarterly team\-building events

  

 At TP\-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Beyond compliance, we strive to create a supportive and growth\-oriented workplace for everyone. If you share our passion and connection to this mission, we welcome you to apply and join us in building a vibrant and inclusive team at TP\-Link Systems Inc.


Please, no third\-party agency inquiries. We are currently unable to offer visa sponsorships.

jobs.description:
**Assistant Manager, Digital Marketing \& Content**  

  

This role is responsible for planning, executing, managing, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels while supporting creative content development for product launches, promotional campaigns, and customer engagement initiatives.  

  

Working under the direction of the Senior Manager, the Assistant Manager will independently manage digital advertising programs, coordinate with advertising agencies and external partners, and collaborate closely with stakeholders in the United States and Japan.  

  

This role will also support omnichannel (OMO) initiatives that connect events, retail experiences, and other offline customer touchpoints with the company's Direct\-to\-Consumer E\-Commerce ecosystem.  

  

The Assistant Manager combines strong performance marketing expertise with a passion for Japanese entertainment properties, collectibles, hobby products, and character brands. This position requires both English and Japanese language capabilities to effectively collaborate with Japan\-based business teams, licensors, and external partners.  

  

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**  

  

**Digital Advertising Management**
* Independently plan, execute, monitor, and optimize digital advertising campaigns to drive customer acquisition, retention, and sales growth for the company's Direct\-to\-Consumer E\-Commerce business.
* Manage advertising campaigns in partnership with media agencies across platforms including:
	+ Google Ads
	+ Instagram Ads
	+ Facebook Ads
	+ TikTok Ads
	+ Reddit Ads
	+ YouTube
	+ Affiliate Marketing Networks
	+ Other emerging digital advertising platforms
* Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable recommendations to improve ROI, ROAS, customer acquisition, and retention metrics.
* Develop media plans and budget recommendations aligned with business objectives and campaign goals.
* Evaluate and test new advertising platforms, technologies, and marketing tools to identify opportunities for business growth.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by introducing new channels, marketing technologies, and innovative advertising approaches based on product characteristics, campaign objectives, and market trends.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and platform developments to identify new growth opportunities.

**Omnichannel (OMO) Marketing Initiative**
* Support and execute omnichannel marketing initiatives that connect offline customer touchpoints with the company's Direct\-to\-Consumer E\-Commerce business.
* Develop and manage customer acquisition and engagement programs that bridge online and offline experiences.
* Support the implementation of event\-related initiatives at conventions, exhibitions, pop\-up stores, and retail locations, including San Diego Comic\-Con, New York Comic Con, and other consumer\-facing events.
* Collaborate with internal teams and technology partners to leverage POS systems, customer data platforms, loyalty programs, QR\-code activations, and marketing technologies that enhance customer engagement.
* Develop strategies to drive customer registrations, membership acquisition, repeat purchases, and digital engagement from offline channels.
* Support initiatives connecting physical retail stores and event sales activities with online customer journeys and E\-Commerce experiences.
* Analyze the effectiveness of omnichannel marketing programs and identify opportunities for optimization and growth.

**Creative \& Content Development**
* Manage the development and production of creative assets including:
	+ Website banners
	+ Landing page content
	+ Promotional videos
	+ Social media content
	+ Email marketing creatives
	+ Digital advertising assets
* Develop creative briefs and work closely with internal teams, agencies, and production vendors.
* Coordinate video production projects and marketing content development.
* Review creative assets to ensure brand consistency, product accuracy, licensing compliance, and campaign effectiveness.
* Assist in developing marketing messaging and campaign concepts tailored to specific fan communities and target audiences.
* Manage the overall creative production workflow from briefing, scheduling, review, approval, and delivery to ensure timely and accurate campaign execution.

**Cross\-Functional \& International Collaboration**
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders in the United States and Japan to support marketing campaigns, product launches, promotions, and licensing initiatives.
* Communicate regularly with Japan headquarters, licensors, and external agencies in both English and Japanese.
* Support the localization and implementation of marketing initiatives developed by Japan\-based teams.
* Facilitate communication and project coordination among internal departments, licensors, creative partners, and advertising agencies.

**Project \& Budget Management**
* Manage campaign timelines, project schedules, and stakeholder communications.
* Track advertising spend and maintain budget reporting.
* Support forecasting, reporting, and performance reviews.
* Ensure timely execution of campaign deliverables and project milestones.

jobs.title: Medical Device Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Medical Device Inside Sales Representative**

**$24\.00/hour During Paid Training \| Base Pay \+ Uncapped Commission After Training \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Irvine, CA**

**Join a Team That Supports Healthcare Excellence**


USOC Medical is seeking a motivated and relationship\-driven **Medical Device Inside Sales Representative** to join our growing team in Irvine, CA. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, prospecting for new business, and helping healthcare providers find reliable medical equipment repair solutions.


This is a performance\-driven sales role where success is measured by activity, customer relationships, and revenue growth. If you're energized by sales, enjoy speaking with customers, and are motivated by uncapped commission opportunities, we'd love to meet you.

**About USOC Medical**


At USOC Medical, our mission is to enhance healthcare by delivering exceptional medical equipment services that prioritize quality, reliability, and innovation. We are committed to building long\-term partnerships with healthcare providers through trust, integrity, and an unwavering dedication to excellence.


Our team helps hospitals, surgery centers, and healthcare facilities maximize the performance and lifespan of their medical equipment through expert repair services, customized solutions, and responsive customer support. jobs.title: Program Specialist II - Clinical Programs (Respiratory Health/HIV)
jobs.description:
Description:
**Position Summary:**


The Clinical Program Specialist II (Respiratory Health \& HIV) serves as an experienced direct care, navigation, and outreach lead within Roots’ Clinical Programs department. Representing Roots Community Health Center, this role blends clinical program support, patient outreach, care coordination, and health education focused on high\-priority conditions including HIV, sexual health, asthma, COVID\-19, and infectious respiratory diseases.


As a Level II specialist, the incumbent manages larger patient panels and leads field\-based outreach initiatives targeted at eliminating health disparities in underserved, low\-income, and unsheltered communities.


Requirements:#### **Essential Functions:**

#### **Direct Care Coordination \& Patient Navigation**

* Serve as a direct liaison between patients and Roots' Clinical Programs, facilitating seamless recruitment, enrollment, intake, and longitudinal care retention.
* Manage and track large client panel lists, using prioritization skills to schedule and confirm program initiation, specialist referrals, and routine follow\-up visits.
* Conduct patient intakes and comprehensive assessments (both in\-person and via phone), connecting patients to Patient Services for public benefit enrollment (e.g., Medi\-Cal, CalFresh, CalWORKS) and basic needs support.
* Assist patients in understanding disease management concepts and guidelines for HIV prevention/treatment (including PrEP/PEP) and respiratory care (e.g., asthma control, COVID\-19 management).
* Partner closely with internal navigation teams, medical providers, and clinic staff to ensure an uninterrupted continuum of care and share patient progress updates.

#### **Outreach, In\-Reach, \& Community Engagement**

* Conduct targeted phone outreach and clinic "in\-reach" to existing patients to build awareness and engagement in HIV and Respiratory Health programs.
* Lead field and street\-based outreach to engage hard\-to\-reach populations, including individuals living in encampments, shelters, or temporary housing.
* Represent Roots as an instrumental lead during weekend and evening community outreach events, managing on\-site logistics, health screenings, and harm\-reduction education.
* Build and maintain collaborative partnerships with local Emergency Departments, Community\-Based Organizations, and local health initiatives to streamline external patient referrals.

#### **Documentation, Data \& Program Support**

* Maintain up\-to\-date, highly accurate records of all patient encounters, referrals, and outreach activities across Electronic Health Record systems and specialized tracking databases.
* Ensure strict adherence to HIPAA compliance and patient privacy standards across all interactions and data entries.
* Assist program leadership in tracking program and contract deliverables tied to HIV and respiratory grants, identifying operational bottlenecks or data collection gaps.
* Meet regularly with Program Coordinators and Managers for case reviews, workflow planning, and program strategy development.

### **Education \& Certification Requirements**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or GED required. Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Social Work, or a related field preferred.
* **Certification:** Completion of an accredited Community Health Worker certification program (or willingness to complete within 6 months of hire).
* **Lived Experience:** Lived experience within or a strong connection to the communities served by Roots Community Health Center.

### **Preferred Qualifications \& Work Experience**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in community health, social services, patient navigation, or public health programs (preferably within a non\-profit organization or community clinic).
* Experience working with high\-priority clinical conditions, such as HIV/STIs, respiratory illnesses, substance use disorders, or chronic disease management.
* Demonstrated background in conducting community outreach and collaborating with multidisciplinary clinical teams.

**Core Competencies**

* **Non\-Judgmental Advocacy:** Ability to discuss stigmatized health topics (HIV, sexual health, harm reduction) empathetically without bias or stigma.
* **Cross\-Cultural Competency:** Strong ability to connect respectfully with diverse populations, including low\-income individuals, unsheltered communities, and communities of color.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Experience navigating Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, client tracking spreadsheets, and G\-Suite/Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* **Organizational Skills:** Excellent time management skills with the ability to balance client case management, panel prioritization, and event planning.
* **Flexibility:** Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings and weekends for outreach activities.
* **Driver’s License:** Valid California Driver’s License with a safe driving record (or ability to obtain).

### **Physical Demands \& Working Conditions**

* Frequent standing, walking, stair climbing, bending, stooping, and lifting up to 25 lbs.
* Gross and fine manual dexterity to operate standard office equipment and keyboards.
* Ability to work both indoors within a clinic environment and outdoors during street\-based outreach or community events.

---------------


Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

We're hiring a Recruiting Coordinator to own the machinery behind our hiring — the systems, process, and enablement that let recruiters and hiring managers move fast without dropping anything. This is not a scheduling\-only role: you'll get into the guts of our ATS, build the reports that tell us where hiring is working and where it's stuck, and stand up new programs end to end. You'll sit at the center of every hire, balancing the needs of recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates, and you'll have real ownership over how talent ops runs as we scale. jobs.title: Care Coordination & Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About TLC Nurse Solutions**

TLC Nurse Solutions is a women\-owned California nurse registry thoughtfully coordinating experienced independent Registered Nurses (RNs) and Licensed Vocational Nurses (LVNs) with private\-pay clients and healthcare partners throughout California.

Our Care Coordination \& Office Operations Team is at the heart of that work. We coordinate referrals, schedules, communication, documentation, credentialing, and billing support while helping clients, nurses, and healthcare partners feel informed and well supported.

**About the Position**

This is a hands\-on role within a collaborative, growing small business. Priorities can shift throughout the day as new referrals arrive, schedules change, or a client or nurse needs timely assistance. The right person enjoys bringing calm and organization to a responsive environment, takes genuine ownership of their work, and follows important details through to completion.

Every team member is cross\-trained in TLC's core operations so we can support one another, provide dependable coverage, and continue improving how we work.

**What You Will Do**

· Coordinate new and ongoing nursing referrals, schedules, and coverage needs.

· Communicate professionally and compassionately with clients, families, independent nurses, specialty pharmacies, physicians, healthcare facilities, case managers, discharge planners, and other referral partners.

· Respond to phone calls, emails, text messages, and faxes in a timely and organized manner.

· Manage schedule changes, cancellations, urgent coverage requests, and other time\-sensitive needs.

· Review nursing documentation for completeness and process it promptly.

· Assist with client invoicing, contractor invoice processing, and related follow\-up.

· Maintain accurate scheduling, credentialing, compliance, and operational records.

· Follow written Standard Operating Procedures while helping identify practical workflow improvements.

· Support teammates and participate in shared evening, weekend, and holiday on\-call coverage.

**Who Thrives Here**

People who thrive at TLC care about doing things well, helping others, and contributing to the organization as a whole. They tend to:

· Take ownership, show initiative, and follow responsibilities through to completion.

· Stay organized, responsive, and attentive to details while managing multiple priorities.

· Communicate clearly, kindly, and proactively.

· Remain calm, thoughtful, and solution\-focused when circumstances change.

· Use sound judgment, make confident routine decisions, and ask questions when collaboration is helpful.

· Notice what needs attention and help move it forward.

· Enjoy learning how different parts of a growing organization work together.

· Value teamwork, flexibility, accountability, and exceptional client service.

**Qualifications**

· **Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) preferred.**

· Strong organizational, written communication, and verbal communication skills.

· Comfort managing multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow\-through.

· Ability to work independently and contribute to a close, collaborative team.

· Comfort learning scheduling, credentialing, documentation, communication, and office systems.

· Healthcare administration, care coordination, scheduling, office operations, or customer service experience is helpful.

Healthcare experience is valuable, and we place equal importance on judgment, emotional intelligence, professionalism, adaptability, curiosity, and a genuine sense of responsibility.

**Schedule, Compensation \& Benefits**

· Full\-time position starting at $33\-$35 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

· Flexible scheduling with a thoughtful combination of office and remote work when appropriate.

· Shared evening, weekend, and holiday on\-call support; working hours may be adjusted to help maintain balance and keep schedules within 40 hours per week.

· Health insurance benefits and retirement savings plan.

· Structured training, written SOPs, cross\-training, and opportunities to take on greater responsibility as TLC grows.

**Apply**

We would be happy to meet dependable, thoughtful candidates who enjoy helping others and want to grow with TLC. Above all, client care comes first in everything we do.

Pay: $33\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, and managing customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), cloud technical support, cloud escalation management, or cloud consulting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, problem\-solving, and client management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the successful adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the technical facets of their Google Cloud transformation journey. You will manage the successful delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services. In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including leadership of enterprises and a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $114000 \- $163000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goal and business transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs in order to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development. Lead across multiple work streams and teams to maintain customer momentum.
* Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand customer’s business, develop roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.
* Plan for customer events and launches, partnering with Support, Engineers, and Site Reliability Engineers to ensure customer success, and work with customers and Support to guide issues/escalations to resolution.
* Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives to scale through partners and accelerate Google Cloud adoption.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager, Developer Relations - Hitachi
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the boundless possibilities of AI to develop the next era of computing. In this era, GPUs, accelerated software, and AI factories become the brains of computers, robots, industrial systems, and autonomous machines.


As a Global Account Manager, Developer Relations, you will lead the technical efforts to advance integration of NVIDIA's libraries, models, and frameworks. This work will focus on Hitachi, one of our largest and most strategic industrial partners. You will partner with product teams at NVIDIA and Hitachi to encourage NVIDIA software integration into Hitachi platforms and solutions. This supports their long\-term business and technical goals. This highly visible position aligns with our product organization to deliver joint solutions that move the needle and with our enterprise go\-to\-market organization to drive mutual success. The ideal candidate brings an outstanding blend of industrial ecosystem fluency, developer advocacy, and strong technical account management experience across energy, mobility, manufacturing, digital engineering, and enterprise AI.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Drive adoption of NVIDIA software libraries, open models, SDKs, NIMs, blueprints, and frameworks across Hitachi business, product, and engineering groups.
* Partner with NVIDIA account, technical, product, and engineering teams to align integration priorities across multiple Hitachi businesses.
* Accelerate critical Hitachi workloads by incorporating the NVIDIA software stack into products, platforms, and pipelines.
* Connect NVIDIA DevTech, Solution Architecture, Developer Relations, and Product Engineering teams with Hitachi stakeholders to advance collaborative development and adoption.
* Engage executive and technical leaders across NVIDIA and Hitachi to guide integrations, resolve technical challenges, track adoption, identify new workflows, and relay field insights.
* Identify differentiated solution opportunities in Physical AI, DSX / AI Factory, Agentic AI, digital twins, edge AI, and industrial automation while fostering Hitachi needs inside NVIDIA.
* Lead multi\-functional partnership execution across product, engineering, solution architecture, GTM, marketing, ecosystem, and co\-sell teams to deliver early wins, lighthouse successes, and long\-term partnership impact.

**What we need to see:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a similar field, or equivalent experience.
* 12\+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in developer relations, product management, technical partnerships, business development, or solutions architecture.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience applying accelerated computing or AI to production workloads, including industrial AI, simulation, computer vision, edge AI, inference, agentic software, data processing, or digital twins.
* Deep understanding of industrial platform ecosystems and the software stack that runs them, including energy infrastructure, rail and mobility, manufacturing, industrial automation, digital engineering, enterprise AI, or IT services.
* Proven ability to structure and implement complex technical engagements, negotiate requirements, prioritize issues, and collaborate with internal and external partners across sales, legal, product, and marketing teams.
* Exceptional ability to distill complex technical concepts and articulate value propositions to audiences ranging from developers to C\-suite executives.
* Experience influencing partner product roadmaps and bringing joint solutions to market with strategic customers or ISV partners.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, or PhD or equivalent experience in computing, electrical engineering, or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA software libraries, frameworks, and models, including CUDA\-X, cuDSS, NIM, NeMo / Nemotron, Cosmos, Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Metropolis, DeepStream, PhysicsNeMo, Holoscan, Jetson, or IGX.
* Deep experience working at or alongside Hitachi, or any major industrial technology partners, developer communities, or technical enablement programs.
* Ability to translate developer sentiment, product requirements, and market shifts into actionable intelligence for industry strategy and product roadmap decisions.
* Domain experience in energy systems, grid modernization, AI factories, autonomous mobility, industrial digital twins, or operational technology / IT convergence.


With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best\-in\-class teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD \- 356,500 USD.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.


Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 7, 2026\.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.


NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.


NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Location:** Burlingame, CA, United States
  

**Date Posted:** Sep 3, 2026
  

**Req number:** JR16128
  

**Job Type:** Regular Full Time
  

**Pay Range:**


75000\.00 to 90000\.00

  

**Description**


**The Best Teams are Created and Maintained Here.**


**Job** **Summary**


* The Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of landscape maintenance clients, building long\-term relationships that promote client satisfaction, retention, and ancillary sales. This role is responsible for overseeing field operations.

**Duties and** **Responsibilities:**


* Identify and pursue opportunities to sell ancillary (enhancement) services to existing clients within the portfolio
* Develop accurate estimates and takeoffs for both new and existing clients as needed
* Deliver timely bid proposals and designs for enhancement projects.
* Generate referrals from existing client base and communicate leads to Business Developer
* Build and maintain strong long\-term relations with clients, focusing on all pertinent points of contact
* Conduct regular site walkthroughs with clients to ensure quality and service expectations are met
* Lead and facilitate the resolution of client concerns or issues (land and/or snow)
* Ensure timely account renewals within the assigned client portfolio
* Proactively assess and address site enhancement needs during visits
* Collaborate with the Operations Manager to ensure service delivery meets or exceeds expectations (land and/or snow)
* Schedule regular site visits with the Operations Manager for quality reviews and to ensure client expectations are met (land and/or snow)
* Support hiring, training, and coaching of field crews for the assigned portfolio
* Promote and enforce safety policies and procedures
* Ensure branch financial goals are met by maintaining acceptable gross margins for both base contract work and ancillary (enhancement) services
* Assist the Branch Manager in overall leadership of the branch to include participation in all relevant meetings
* Maintain proper account documentation and notes in the CRM system
* Monitor and maintain satisfactory accounts receivable levels (land and/or snow)
* Coordinate with the Branch Administrator to keep client records and contact information current
* Perform additional duties as assigned by the Branch Manager

**Education and** **Experience:**


* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a business\-related field, or equivalent experience in a customer\-focused service industry
* inimum 3 years of experience in customer service, management, and leadership, preferably in the landscaping industry or local marketplace.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated leadership and coaching abilities
* Ability to foster collaboration and teamwork

**Physical** **Demands/Requirements:**


* Operation of a computer and other office equipment/system, such as a laptop, cell phone, and sales and operational programs/tools
* Position is a combination of mobile and sedentary work; must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time
* Customarily and regularly spends more than half of the time working away from BrightView’s places of business, walking job sites, selling and obtaining orders or contracts for BrightView’s services
* Ability to travel by car, train, and plane
* Position needs to be able to traverse uneven grounds and walk on job sites with clients and the branch team for periods of time up to 4 hours
* Ability to maintain, in your possession at all times, required medications to address any known allergic reactions should they occur

**Work** **Environment:**


* Works both indoors and outdoors; attends branch stretch and flex 3\-4 days per week
* Field\-based position, a combination of office and customer\-facing

*BrightView Landscapes, LLC is an Equal Opportunity and E\-Verify Employer.*

*This job description is subject to change at any time*


**Compensation Pay Range:**


75000\.00 to 90000\.00


***BrightView offers a suite or health, wellness, and financial benefits to full\-time team members. Benefits offerings for full\-time team members include medical, dental, and vision insurance, ancillary and voluntary products, a 401k savings plan with employer contributions, and 6 to 9 company paid holidays per year. Employees may also be eligible to receive paid time off for vacation and/or sick leave, tuition reimbursement, and/or potential variable pay opportunities based on position and performance. A detailed benefits package will be provided during the interview process****.*


*It’s Not Just a Team. It’s One BrightView.*

jobs.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Palo Alto
jobs.description:
**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high\-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.



The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.


**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Territory Strategy \& Business Performance**


* Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
* Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
* Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high\-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.


**Strategic Account Management \& Network Development**


* Identify, prioritize, and develop high\-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
* Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision\-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow\-through.
* Map influence and decision\-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
* Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.


**Clinical Aptitude \& Customer Engagement**


* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
* Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
* Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
* Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Influence \& Impact**


* Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
* Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change\-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
* Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries


**Customer, Patient \& Caregiver Impact**


* Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
* Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow\-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
* Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.

jobs.description:
**About Delinea:**  

Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI\-powered intelligence, Delinea’s leading cloud\-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle – across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities – including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines – assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real\-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99\.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.


Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world\-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.

  

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

**Strategic Account Manager Summary:**


This remote position requires a motivated self\-starter who will be responsible for all net new sales into Strategic Accounts, $20 Billion and above as defined by Delinea based on annual revenue. These represent Delinea’s most strategic and sophisticated client relationships.


Covering a specific accounts list rather than a geographic region, the candidate may be required to travel up to 50% to visit customers, attend field events, and for internal meetings such as sales kick\-offs or quarterly business reviews.

* Apply strong business acumen and Delinea sales methodology to every prospective customer engagement
* Achieve/exceed quota targets, while developing satisfied and referenceable customers
* Effectively prospect to uncover sales opportunities within assigned territory
* Lead complex sales\-cycles and effectively present the value of our applications to C\-level executives of organizations
* Build and maintain relationships with influencers and decision\-makers
* Quickly understand business challenges and create solutions.
* Manage sales pipeline and ensure CRM accuracy
* Learn how solutions meet needs of clients and develop skill solution focused selling
* Work with marketing and sales teams to develop target strategies
* Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximize profits
* Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives
* Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders
* Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement to meet sales quotas
* Forecast and track key account metrics (e.g. quarterly sales results and annual forecasts)
* Collaborate with sales teams to identify and grow opportunities within territory

**What You'll Bring:**

* 10\+ years of experience successfully selling ROI\-driven, Enterprise\-Wide SaaS/Subscription/Cloud Applications to C\-level decision makers within $20bn\+ organizations.
* Experience selling Professional Services as part of outcome\-based solution selling
* Ability to demonstrate software offerings at a detailed level, develop innovative value propositions to maximize sales revenue, and negotiate and close under time and objective pressure
* Demonstrated success in working with the channel partner and alliance ecosystem
* Proven track record as an avid hunter, with experience closing complex sales cycles in a consultative manner, who consistently exceeds quota
* Thrill of generating and executing strategic plans for closing new logos and growing key accounts
* Flexibility and ability to thrive selling as an individual, while effectively communicating the technical and business value of Delinea solutions to all prospect stakeholders in prospect base
* Proficiency with sales automation applications and technologies, particularly SFDC forecasting and reporting
* Familiarity with sales process frameworks, specifically MEDDPICC
* Understand and leverage organization structure and dynamics to support the strategy, culture, and priorities of the company
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills
* Ability to travel up to 50%

**Bonus if You Have:**

* Experience in cybersecurity industry
* Privileged Access Management or Identity Access Management experience
* Bachelor's Degree

* We're passionate problem\-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.
* We invest in people who are smart, self\-motivated, and collaborative.

* Trust \- We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

* Global \- We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

jobs.title: FOIL Account Manager
jobs.description:

Whether it is in the design and safety of new generations of cars, trucks and planes, or optimizing advanced medical equipment and consumer products, VPG’s deep engineering expertise is making the world safer, smarter, and productive.


We are seeking a results\-driven **Account Manager** to lead strategic account growth, drive design\-win activity, and manage key distribution partner relationships across high\-growth technology markets.


This role is responsible for developing executive\-level customer relationships, creating growth strategies, expanding market share, and coordinating internal resources to maximize customer success and revenue growth.

* Develop and execute strategic growth plans for assigned key accounts and industry verticals.

* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience using CRM and forecasting tools.

**Travel:** Approximately 30\-50% throughout North America.

  

Region:
  

North America

jobs.title: OEM Account Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for someone who thrives in a multifaceted organization, helps partners succeed, and wants to help drive the future of accelerated computing! We are growing our Strategic OEM sales team and looking for a highly motivated, experienced OEM Account Manager to help manage one of our top OEM partners and drive adoption of NVIDIA accelerated computing platforms in selected shared markets. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a consistent track record working in complex sales cycles and account management, meeting key objectives, and exceeding revenue goals in a partner\-led sales model. To succeed in this role, you must have comprehensive knowledge of the GPU server market and NVIDIA networking. Proven sales management experience and the ability to build strong business relationships with senior executives are also required.

**What you’ll be doing:**


In this role, you will support the selling and adoption of assigned NVIDIA product lines and align the partner's business objectives with NVIDIA across the vertical markets we serve. Join the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) Industry team to execute on the industry strategy by working backwards and in collaboration with the world’s most innovative companies. jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**  

Bobyard uses AI to take contractors from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. We're Series A backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear ($35M — 2x the median raise), and our customers are running real construction jobs on Bobyard right now, not sitting through a demo.

 **About the Role**  

Implementation Specialist runs the day\-to\-day work of getting new mid\-market customers live and trained on Bobyard. We're building this role because launch quality can't scale on ad hoc effort — someone needs to own kickoff calls, configuration, and training as a repeatable motion, at volume. You'll win when a customer's team is actually using Bobyard on real jobs, not just logged in, and when you can run that outcome across a full book of accounts every month, not just one at a time.

 **What You'll Do**

* Run kickoff calls and configure new mid\-market accounts so they're ready to go within days of signature, not weeks
* Deliver hands\-on training that gets real crews — estimators, PMs, field staff — actually using Bobyard, not just clicking through a demo
* Own a high\-volume book of concurrent launches and keep every one of them moving without dropping details
* Run repeatable training sessions and office hours, refining the curriculum as you see what actually lands with users
* Catch stragglers early — flag accounts that are stalling before they quietly go dark
* Document account context well enough that Customer Success can pick it up cold with zero re\-explaining
* Feed real, specific product and training feedback back to Product and Customer Success

 **What We're Looking For**

* 2\+ years in a customer\-facing SaaS role — onboarding, implementation, training, or customer success
* Comfortable running live training for non\-technical or field\-based users, not just technical buyers
* Can juggle a high\-volume portfolio of accounts at once without losing the thread on any of them
* Clear, concrete written communication — your notes are why the next person never has to ask what happened
* Hands\-on with software yourself — you configure things, you don't wait on someone else to do it
* Genuinely energized by construction, trades, or other real\-world industries
* No SaaS background required if you've got the industry instead — if you've run estimates, managed jobs, or worked the trades and want to move into tech, you'll pick this up fast

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience in vertical SaaS or construction tech
* Familiarity with CRM or onboarding tooling (Salesforce, Asana, Notion)
* Prior experience in construction, estimating, or the trades
* Bilingual (Spanish or otherwise) — useful with field crews

 **What We Offer**
  

  

$85,000–$110,000 base salary, plus equity. Based in San Francisco, on\-site with the team at 101 2nd Street.

 **Comp Philosophy**

We are proud to offer competitive, top\-of\-market compensation because we want to celebrate the dedicated people who ship amazing work and drive our success. Our individual compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on your role, experience, and contributions, alongside performance\-based rewards.


Compensation Range: $85K \- $100K

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**Strategy \& Operations Associate**

**San Francisco, CA: Financial District. In\-Person (M\-F)**

We are very excited to be hiring our first Strategy \& Operations (BizOps) Associate. You'll go wherever the operation is breaking, scope the problem, build the fix, and hand it off. And you'll do it AI\-natively — we expect the person in this seat to replace manual work with agents and internal tooling rather than absorb it as headcount. How we run ourselves internally should look like the product we sell: it's part of our advantage, not back\-office overhead.


Finance operations and reporting are the anchor — the numbers, the close, the board deck, the dashboard everyone actually looks at — but the role doesn't stop at Finance. You'll sit at the center of the company, supporting both sides of the org: GTM (sales, marketing, product, customer success) and Engineering \& Design. You'll work directly with the founders and every function lead here. Most of what you'll own doesn't exist yet — you'll be the one who builds it.


No two weeks look the same, and that's the point. You'll report to the Chief of Staff and rotate across finance operations, GTM reporting, and eng/design operations — owning real work in each, not observing. The scope is wide because the company moves fast and the problems don't respect org charts. This role is for someone genuinely comfortable with ambiguity \- scopes shifts week to week.

**Why FurtherAI?**

* **Elite Team \& Culture:** Join a YC and a16z\-backed startup, collaborating with industry experts who share your hunger and ambition. Be part of a culture built for high performers who are proud to put in the work.
* **Transformative Opportunity:** Sell pioneering AI solutions in complex, regulated industries and help modernize a trillion\-dollar sector.
* **Leadership Growth:** Leverage your experience to shape our sales process and grow into a senior leadership role as the company scales.
* **Highly Competitive Compensation:** Strong base salary, top\-tier commission plan, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

**What You'll Do**

* **Put AI to work inside FurtherAI.** Find the work people are doing that AI should be doing instead. Build AI workflows and internal tooling that eliminate manual steps across finance and ops, and become the person the team comes to for what's worth automating and how.
* **Support FinOps and cost discipline.** Track infrastructure and vendor costs, pull the analysis that shows where the money is going, flag what looks off, and support the work to bring it down.
* **Build the reporting the company runs on.** Create and maintain the KPI dashboards, board materials, and recurring reports leadership actually uses to make decisions — revenue, pipeline, burn, headcount, and beyond.
* **Support GTM.** Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product and Customer Success on pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and the data and materials they need to hit the number.
* **Support Engineering \& Design.** Partner with Engineering and Design on headcount and hiring plans, tooling, and the operational rhythm that keeps a fast\-moving product org organized.
* **Run cross\-functional projects end to end.** Pricing analyses, market sizing, competitive research, fundraising prep, or whatever ambiguous work doesn't belong to any one team — you scope it, run it, and land it, working with the COO/Chief of Staff to prioritize what matters most this week.
* **Own the mechanics of money moving in and out.** Vendor onboarding and payments, customer invoicing, billing accuracy, collections follow\-up, and expense workflows, plus the monthly close, cash tracking, and budget\-vs\-actuals. Turn what lives in someone's inbox into a process that runs on its own.

**Who You Are**

* You've been the best at something — top of your class, captain of the team, first in your cohort — and you're looking for the next thing to pour that into.
* At every past job you ended up doing more than your title said.
* You have a builder's instinct for process — when something breaks twice, you redesign it; when a task eats four hours every week, you make it run itself.
* You're as comfortable in a spreadsheet or financial model as you are in a room with Sales or Engineering.
* You get energy from moving fast across many problems, not sitting in one lane.
* You'd rather own a messy problem end\-to\-end than execute a clean task someone handed you.
* You context\-switch without losing intensity, and you care about outcomes over job descriptions.

**Requirements**

* 2–4\+ years in a high\-paced environment \- MBB, Investment Banking, or similar required.
* Genuinely AI\-native — you already use LLMs and agents as leverage in your own work and have built things with them, not just used a chatbot to draft an email.
* Strong financial and analytical skills — comfortable building and stress\-testing a model, not just reading one, and pulling your own numbers without waiting on someone else.
* Extremely high attention to detail — this role touches money moving in and out of the company, and small errors are expensive.
* Strong written and verbal communication across Finance, GTM, and Engineering — you can write a crisp update, chase an overdue invoice professionally, and explain a process to someone with no context.
* Bias toward action; based in San Francisco or willing to relocate immediately.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in Insurtech, Fintech, etc, or B2B SaaS at a high\-growth technology company.
* Hands\-on experience with financial systems (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Ramp, Rippling, or similar) and BI/reporting or internal\-tooling platforms (Looker, Retool, Sigma, Zapier, or similar).
* Prior startup or founder experience.
* Exposure to sales/GTM operations and/or engineering program management.

**You can look forward to the following benefits:**

* Fully covered, best\-in\-class health, dental, and vision benefits
* Competitive Compensation, meaningful stock options, company 401(k)
* Unli

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
**About Sirona Medical**
------------------------



At **Sirona Medical**, we're building software that enables physicians to work as fast as they can think.



Each year in the U.S., **billions of patient images** are captured—and nearly all of them are reviewed and diagnosed by radiologists. These specialists are the central hub of diagnostic medicine: **over 80% of all healthcare data flows through radiology IT systems**. Yet despite their pivotal role, radiologists are overburdened by outdated, fragmented software which limits their efficiency and ultimately the quality and efficiency of care that health systems can provide patients. That's where Sirona comes in.



We're a **San Francisco\-based, cloud\-native software company** with employees around the world. Our deep understanding of both the **practice and business of radiology** has allowed us to build **RadOS**—a unified, AI\-powered operating system powering the entire radiology workflows.


### **How Sirona Solves the Problem**



Sirona is **uniquely positioned to transform the way radiology is practiced**. We're delivering the organizational shift that both individual radiologists and entire practices urgently need:


* A **unified**, intuitive, and **platform\-agnostic** solution
* A streamlined workspace that makes **every part of the radiologist's workflow faster and easier**
* The freedom to **read from anywhere, for anyone**

By cutting clicks, optimizing diagnostic time, and unlocking efficiencies that extend **far beyond the reading room into all care settings**, Sirona empowers radiologists—and in doing so, we help the entire healthcare system move faster, smarter, and with greater impact on patient outcomes.

For more information, please visit https://sironamedical.com/join/.
As a Sales Development Representative, you will be pivotal in driving Sirona Medical's growth by identifying and engaging potential new clients, showcasing how our innovative radiology solutions can transform their operations. You are the initial point of contact, tasked with sparking interest and paving the way for in\-depth sales discussions.



As we build and refine our Go\-To\-Market (GTM) motion, this role offers significant opportunity for growth and career development. You'll play a pivotal part in shaping how we engage the market, collaborate cross\-functionally, and scale our impact — with a clear path to take on more strategic responsibility as we grow.



This is a remote position from within the United States.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Lead Generation: Use targeted strategies to identify potential clients in the healthcare sector, focusing on how our integrated radiology systems can meet their needs.
* Qualification of Leads: Assess the potential of leads to benefit from our unified platform, including our advanced viewer and AI\-enhanced diagnostic tools.
* Appointment Setting: Arrange detailed discussions between prospects and sales executives, emphasizing the benefits and efficiencies our solutions offer.
* CRM Management: Keep meticulous records of interactions and statuses in our CRM system, ensuring all team members have up\-to\-date information.
* Market Research: Keep abreast of technological advancements and competitive developments in radiology to refine and enhance sales pitches.
* Collaboration: Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to refine approaches based on market feedback and new product capabilities.
* Performance Metrics: Consistently meet or exceed monthly targets for qualified leads and arranged meetings.


**Key Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a relevant field.
* 1\-2 years experience in sales development or lead generation, ideally within healthcare technology.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient with CRM systems, such as Salesforce or Hubspot.
* Resilient in handling rejections and motivated by challenges.
* Strong organizational and time management abilities.
* Energetic, results\-driven, and committed to ongoing learning and professional development.


**Benefits:**


* Generous Compensation Plan with Uncapped upside potential
* Stock Options
* Unlimited PTO
* Medical, dental, vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Maternity and Paternity Leave
* 401K matching
* Apple equipment
* Sponsorship for conferences, continuing education, etc.


The annual US base salary for this full\-time position is $75,000 \+ 20% commission \+ additional 1% pool of total contracted ARR through the balance of this fiscal year \+ equity \+ benefits. Pay scale is flexible depending on experience. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, competencies, experience, relevant education and training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**ABOUT SPHERE**
----------------


Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Compliance is one of the last and largest — and the hardest, because trade rules aren't data to be looked up. They're a complex adaptive system with 190\+ sovereign jurisdictions, in different languages, changing constantly, reacting to each other.


Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts. We handle the entire lifecycle — calculation, registration, filing, remittance — at millisecond latency with zero downtime.

* **Backed by a16z and YC.** $21M Series A, 30%\+ month\-over\-month growth, customers include ElevenLabs, Replit, Deel, Runway, and Lovable.
* **Small team, global surface area**. Everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. San Francisco, five days in office.
* **The problem keeps compounding.** Expanding into input tax, withholding, e\-invoicing, tariffs — each multiplies the complexity. Tens of millions of transactions today, billions ahead.

  

**THE ROLE**
------------


Sphere is looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build our outbound sales engine.


You'll work directly with our Account Executives and Founder to identify the companies we should be selling to, understand why Sphere matters to them, and create opportunities with CFOs, Controllers, Tax leaders, and other senior finance executives.


This isn't a role where you'll inherit a finished playbook and spend your day running someone else's sequences. You'll be expected to prospect relentlessly, learn quickly, experiment with what works, and help us build the playbook as we go.

**This role is designed to be a path into an Account Executive position at Sphere.** You'll get exposure to the full sales cycle from day one, learn directly from our AEs and the founder, and take on more responsibility as you prove you're ready. We want to develop our next generation of AEs from within.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Build and own targeted account lists across our core markets.
* Prospect into CFOs, Controllers, Heads of Tax, and other senior finance leaders.
* Research companies to understand their business model, global footprint, and why Sphere could matter to them.
* Create pipeline through phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and creative outbound.
* Work directly with AEs on account strategy, messaging, and multithreading.
* Learn how to qualify real business problems rather than simply book meetings.
* Get exposure to discovery, demos, deal strategy, negotiation, and closing.
* Take on increasing ownership of opportunities as you develop.
* Experiment constantly with messaging, targeting, signals, and new ways to create pipeline.
* Help build the outbound playbook that future SDRs at Sphere will inherit.

  

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

* You want to build a career in B2B sales and eventually own a number.
* You're a strong communicator and comfortable starting conversations with people more senior than you.
* You're competitive, curious, and willing to put in the reps.
* You learn quickly and actively seek feedback.
* You're comfortable operating in an environment where the answer isn't always obvious.
* You take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.
* You're excited to work alongside the team in our San Francisco office five days a week.

  

**NICE TO HAVES**
-----------------

* Previous SDR experience is helpful, but not required. We're more interested in trajectory than pedigree.
* Previous outbound sales or prospecting experience.
* Experience at an early stage startup.
* Experience selling or working with Finance, Accounting, or Tax teams.
* Evidence that you've been exceptional at something competitive, whether that's sales, athletics, academics, entrepreneurship, or something else.

  

**WHO YOU ARE**
---------------

*You'll thrive here if:*

* **You're a Dog.** You've been underestimated, gone through struggle, and never stopped running. You have a chip on your shoulder and enormous drive. You look at Stripe, Deel, and Flexport all punting on compliance and think: *good, that means the opportunity is ours.* Hunger beats pedigree.
* **Early stage is in your bones.** You've built things where there's no playbook and nobody handing you the answer. You define the problem instead of waiting for instructions.
* **You own it end to end.** Give you a goal and you figure out your own path. Small team, global surface area — everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. No one tells you how.
* **You believe speed and accuracy are both possible.** We're building a complex product that requires robustness and 100% uptime, and we have to build at our customers' pace. Move fast. Don't break things. Both.
* **Being in the room is a feature, not a cost.** Five days in SF isn't a policy, it's how the work gets done. The speed and density of collaboration we need doesn't survive over video.

 *This won't be a fit if:*

* You need structure handed to you or ambiguity feels draining rather than motivating
* You want to manage people more than own hard problems (we're a flat, experienced team — everyone builds)
* You're used to "good enough" shipping (small errors have outsized impact here)
* Being in the room five days a week feels like a cost instead of a benefit


Compensation Range: $75K \- $140K
