Company: Indigo Promotions  
Location: North Bergen, NJ, In Person  
Job Type: Full Time  
Experience Level: Entry Level  
Compensation: $18\.00 to $20\.00 per hour

About Indigo Promotions:

Indigo Promotions is a minority\-owned branded merchandise company that creates custom products, apparel, packaging, event giveaways, and corporate gifting programs for leading global brands. We manage creative, deadline\-driven projects through domestic suppliers, overseas factories, and our in\-house production capabilities.

Position Overview:

Indigo Promotions is seeking an organized, dependable, and highly detail\-oriented Order and Production Coordinator to join our team.

This is an entry\-level position with hands\-on training provided. You will learn how to create purchase orders, communicate with suppliers and factories, monitor production schedules, review order details, and help ensure projects are completed accurately and delivered on time.

The goal is for this person to gradually take ownership of the production coordination process for an assigned group of clients. No promotional products experience is required, but you must be organized, comfortable following detailed processes, and willing to take responsibility for keeping projects on track.

Responsibilities:

* Create purchase orders with accurate pricing, quantities, product specifications, artwork instructions, shipping information, and delivery dates.
* Communicate regularly with domestic suppliers and overseas factories to request updates and keep orders moving.
* Monitor production schedules and confirm that projects remain on track for their required delivery dates.
* Request and organize virtual proofs, product samples, production photos, tracking information, and shipping documents.
* Carefully review purchase orders, proofs, and production details for accuracy before orders move forward.
* Track projects from the time an order is placed through production, shipping, and final delivery.
* Keep CommonSku and internal project trackers updated with accurate order information.
* Notify the team immediately about potential delays, inventory problems, artwork concerns, or production issues.
* Help coordinate solutions when an order encounters a production or shipping problem.
* Maintain clear records of factory conversations, approvals, deadlines, and project updates.
* Learn Indigo Promotions’ production procedures and gradually take ownership of assigned orders and client projects.
* Assist with estimates, sales orders, invoices, and client presentations when needed.
* Handle additional production and operational responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications and Skills:

* This is an entry\-level position, and previous promotional products or production experience is not required.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to review information carefully.
* Excellent organization and time\-management skills.
* Clear and professional written communication.
* Ability to follow established procedures while learning when to ask questions or escalate an issue.
* Comfortable managing several assignments and deadlines at the same time.
* Dependable, responsive, and willing to follow through until a task is completed.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities may change.
* Basic proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Docs.
* Willingness to learn CommonSku and other order\-management tools.
* Experience in customer service, administration, purchasing, logistics, project coordination, or order processing is helpful but not required.
* Experience communicating with vendors or working across international time zones is a plus.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn from feedback.

Training and Growth:

The Order and Production Coordinator will receive hands\-on training in Indigo Promotions’ systems, supplier relationships, order\-management procedures, and production processes.

The successful candidate will begin by supporting existing production workflows and learning alongside an experienced team member. As their knowledge and confidence grow, they will be expected to independently manage purchase orders, supplier communication, production schedules, and delivery tracking for assigned projects.

Schedule Expectations:

This is a full\-time, in\-person position. Because Indigo Promotions works with overseas factories and manages time\-sensitive projects, occasional communication outside standard business hours may be required. This is not a 24\-hour on\-call position, but flexibility may be needed when an urgent production matter arises.

Additional Information:

Indigo Promotions is an equal opportunity employer offering competitive compensation, hands\-on training, and opportunities for professional growth.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone beginning their career who wants to develop practical experience in production, purchasing, operations, logistics, and branded merchandise.

To apply, please submit your resume directly to ethan@indigopromos.com.

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

Buttons Sound is a New York sound production company with approximately **40 years of experience evolving with—and helping advance—changes in entertainment, media and audio technology.**

Our history spans television, film, advertising, voice recording and audio post\-production, including helping launch **Pokémon in the U.S. with Episodes 1–52**.

Today, we are bringing that same spirit of innovation into the rapidly growing world of **AI Speech Dataset production**, developing new technology and production workflows for capturing, managing, verifying and delivering high\-quality human speech data for artificial intelligence.

· CRM development, documentation,

The goal is to make every working hour productive while giving the right person exposure to many different aspects of operating and growing a sound and AI Speech Dataset business.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Our Company:** Originally founded in 1975, BCI has continually evolved to become a leader in the women’s fashion industry. Launching initially with CHAUS and private label lines and then expanding into a multi\-brand platform business, we have been at the forefront of market trends and the changing retail environment.


Our brands, including CeCe, Vince Camuto, Ted Baker, 1\.State and Parker, each serve unique customer demographics but are united in their commitment to quality and style. As we expand our presence, BCI remains dedicated to innovation, excellence, and women’s empowerment through fashion.

**THE ROLE:**


We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented **Logistics Coordinator** to join our Logistics team. The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in international logistics and experience coordinating shipments from vendors/factories through final delivery.


This role is highly collaborative and requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple shipments, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously. The Logistics Coordinator will work closely with freight forwarders, overseas vendors/factories, and internal departments including Production, Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure shipments move efficiently and arrive on time.


In addition to core logistics responsibilities, this position will support our GS1 program, UCC\-128 carton labeling, cartonization, and factory coordination, making this an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to expand their logistics expertise within the apparel industry.

**Ideal Candidate**


The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of shipments from start to finish. They should be confident communicating with vendors and logistics partners, while also being able to work effectively with multiple internal departments.


Most importantly, this person should have a strong logistics coordination foundation and be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. Experience with GS1/UCC\-128, cartonization, and factory operations is a strong advantage, but the ability to learn and grow in these areas is equally important.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Shipment \& Logistics Management*

* Track and monitor international and domestic shipments from origin through final delivery.
* Maintain accurate shipment status updates and proactively identify potential delays or issues.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, carriers, customs brokers, 3PL warehouses, and other logistics partners.
* Follow up with vendors/factories regarding shipment readiness, booking information, ETDs, ETAs, documentation, and delivery requirements.
* Review shipping documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Communicate shipment delays, changes, and exceptions to the appropriate internal teams.
* Ensure shipments meet required delivery dates and company guidelines.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and provide regular reporting and updates to the Logistics team.

*Vendor \& Factory Coordination*

* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with overseas vendors and factories.
* Communicate directly with factories regarding shipping requirements, production readiness, carton information, and documentation.
* Work closely with vendors to resolve shipment discrepancies, delays, documentation issues, and other logistics\-related concerns.
* Ensure factories understand and follow company shipping and labeling requirements.
* Partner with Production and other teams to align factory readiness with shipping timelines.
* *Cross\-Functional Communication*
* Work closely with internal departments including Production, Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, and Logistics to ensure accurate and timely flow of information.
* Provide shipment updates and relevant information to internal stakeholders.
* Assist with resolving issues that impact customer delivery dates, inventory availability, or financial processing.
* Serve as a key point of contact between internal teams, vendors, and logistics service providers.

*GS1 / UCC\-128 Program*

* Support and maintain the company’s GS1/UCC\-128 carton labeling program.
* Coordinate with vendors/factories to ensure carton labels are created and applied according to company and customer requirements.
* Review and troubleshoot UCC\-128 label issues and work with factories to correct discrepancies.
* Assist with cartonization of goods, including carton quantities \& ensure compliance within the guidelines of the program.
* Work closely with factories to ensure cartonization and labeling information is accurate before goods ship.
* Help ensure carton information aligns with purchase orders, shipping documentation, and customer requirements.

  

**Requirements**  

* **2\+ years of experience in logistics, transportation,** supply chain, or a related field, preferably in an apparel environment.
* Strong foundation in logistics coordination and shipment tracking.
* Experience working with freight forwarders, vendors, factories, and/or carriers.
* Experience with international shipping and familiarity with import processes preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external teams.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with GS1, UCC\-128 labeling, or retail carton labeling requirements.
* Experience with cartonization, carton packing information, or factory packing compliance.
* Experience working directly with overseas apparel factories.
* Familiarity with ERP systems.

jobs.title: Arterial Account Manager - New York Metro - Peripheral Vascular
jobs.description:
### **Why join Stryker?**


Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.
Are you a strategic, clinically savvy sales professional passionate about driving meaningful impact in vascular care? Join us as an **Arterial Account Manager**, where you’ll operate with autonomy, lead program development, and partner with top physicians and health system leaders to bring life‑changing PAD and CLTI therapies to more patients.


In this high‑visibility role, you’ll collaborate across specialties—including interventionalists, vascular surgeons, service line leadership, and internal cross‑functional teams—to develop, launch, and scale PAD and LimFlow programs. You will also work closely with local Account Managers and Field Clinical Specialists to accelerate adoption and drive growth.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify new growth opportunities and uncover unmet clinical needs within PAD and CLTI patient populations.
* Build alignment with multidisciplinary stakeholders, including physician champions and hospital leadership.
* Drive therapy adoption through clinical expertise, education, and program‑building initiatives.
* Create demand and expand access to the Artix and LimFlow portfolios to grow long‑term franchise value.
* Execute coordinated strategies with VTE Account Managers using shared targets, aligned messaging, and real\-time field insights.
* Deliver high‑impact presentations outlining clinical and financial benefits of the portfolio to physicians and hospital administration.
* Provide valuable product feedback to R\&D and Marketing, serving as a key clinical voice for innovation.
* Represent the company at trade shows, conferences, and educational events.
* Act as a clinical subject matter expert during national calls and training programs.
* Partner with Sales Leadership and Medical Education to support new hire onboarding and ongoing training needs.
* Develop and disseminate insights to internal stakeholders during pre‑sale and evaluation processes.
* Perform other responsibilities as needed to support regional and national initiatives.

**What You Bring**

**Skills \& Abilities**

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong MS Office skills (PowerPoint, Excel, reporting).
* Exceptional presentation skills—from 1:1 settings to large audiences.
* Clinical excellence and comfort in case‑based environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Proven leadership and the ability to educate and develop others.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Passion for delivering patient‑focused, team‑based healthcare solutions.
* Robust sales and business acumen.
* Strong communication habits using company systems and tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science degree in a related field.
* Minimum 6 years of medical device field sales experience.
* Current certifications and vendor credentials.
* Demonstrated history of consistent quota attainment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* At least **2 years of experience with Stryker or Inari** sales/clinical (preferred).
* Previous experience in the **peripheral arterial space**.

**Why This Role Matters**


This is a unique opportunity to shape programs, lead strategic initiatives, and be at the forefront of innovation in PAD and CLTI care. If you thrive in clinically oriented environments, love building partnerships, and want to make a lasting impact on patient outcomes — we’d love to talk.

  

Base \+ commission: $125,000\.00 and may be eligible to earn commission and/or bonuses \+ benefits.


Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD\&D insurance, and short\-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

jobs.title: Confirmed Account Manager
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI\-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000\+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer\-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.


Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.


Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.


At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We’re customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

  

As a Confirmed Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.


By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.


This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota\-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross\-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add\-on SKUs, and build deep, long\-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.


Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market\-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.


**This is a hybrid role based in NYC.**


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Own NRR: Manage the full post\-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
* Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
* Target Strategically: Prioritize high\-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long\-term growth plans.
* Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
* Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi\-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision\-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
* Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head\-to\-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
* Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
* Manage Pipeline \& Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data\-driven NRR forecasting.
* Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.
  

### **Qualifications:**


* Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
* Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
* Customer\-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
* Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
* Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
* Analytical, detail\-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
* Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long\-term value through partnership.
* Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next\-generation AI\-powered communications platform.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

  

**The Role**
------------


As a Mid Market Account Manager, you will own gross dollar retention and drive growth across your book of business. You will be responsible for running renewal cycles, prospecting within your existing accounts to identify expansion opportunities, and upselling and cross selling throughout your book of business. jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI\-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000\+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer\-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.



Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.



Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.



At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  


**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

  

As a Confirmed Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.



By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.



This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota\-carrying seller. You'll partner cross\-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add\-on SKUs, and build deep, long\-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.



Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market\-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.


**This is a hybrid role based in NYC.**


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Own NRR: Manage the full post\-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
* Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
* Target Strategically: Prioritize high\-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long\-term growth plans.
* Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
* Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi\-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision\-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.

* Manage Pipeline \& Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data\-driven NRR forecasting.

* Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
* Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
* Customer\-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
* Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
**Why Join GEICO?**


At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

  

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

  

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

**About the Role:**


Within Product Marketing at GEICO, the digital funnel is where marketing investment either converts or doesn't. This role exists to understand exactly why — and to fix it.


The Digital Marketing Manager, Product Marketing analyzes performance across owned digital channels and the online funnel, identifying where conversion is breaking down, diagnosing root causes, and partnering with Engineering on experiment design and testing to drive improvement. A core part of the role is owning the full ad\-to\-application view: connecting how traffic from performance media and organic channels behaves on\-site, understanding the Martech and measurement ecosystem that enables that view, partnering with SEO/AEO on discoverability and on\-site optimization, and working with Creative on landing page optimization. The output is a single, coherent picture of the digital funnel — and a prioritized, cross\-functional agenda for improving it. The role is also hands\-on day to day: making page\-level content and layout edits directly in the CMS in close collaboration with Creative, SEO and Engineering.


This role requires someone with proven, hands\-on experience in digital analytics and conversion optimization — not just familiarity with the tools, but a track record of diagnosing funnel problems, understanding how Martech and measurement systems shape the data, and driving measurable improvement through experimentation and cross\-functional partnership.

**How We Work:**


The Marketing organization at GEICO is guided by a clear set of principles: we hire the best at every level and invest in developing them. We believe that strategy comes before action — if we don't know why we're doing something, we don't do it. We bring the same care and accountability to how we spend resources as we would if it were our own business. And when there are challenges, we face them directly and collectively. Leaders in this organization are expected to bring that same mindset to their teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Funnel \& Experience Analysis**

* Review the online funnel end\-to\-end — from ad click through completed application — to identify gaps, drop\-off points, and conversion opportunities
* Independently analyze site, funnel, and business performance using analytics tools and operational data
* Identify trends, diagnose root causes, and distinguish between experience issues, traffic quality issues, and execution issues
* Communicate the expected impact of marketing investment changes on site metrics, giving stakeholders a clear before/after view

**Marketing Spend \& Traffic Translation**

* Understand traffic composition by marketing channel (paid search, paid social, affiliate, organic) and how each channel's traffic behaves on\-site
* Translate channel\-level spend and traffic characteristics into expected site performance benchmarks by source
* Surface where upstream channel quality and downstream site metrics tell different stories, and propose experience optimizations tied to how different traffic sources actually behave
* Work closely with Marketing Analytics and channel owners to understand campaign optimizations, traffic mix changes, and their downstream impact on funnel performance

**SEO/AEO, Landing Page Optimization \& CMS Execution**

* Partner with SEO/AEO teams to align on\-site content, structure, and technical performance with organic search and answer\-engine discoverability goals
* Analyze landing page performance by traffic source and campaign, identifying where messaging, layout, or performance is limiting conversion
* Partner with Creative and Engineering to test and refine landing page concepts, translating performance findings into clear briefs and iteration recommendations
* Make hands\-on updates directly in the CMS — copy, imagery, and page\-level layout changes — in collaboration with Creative and Engineering; this is working\-level execution, not ownership of CMS strategy, architecture, or governance

**Experimentation \& Engineering Partnership**

* Partner with Engineering to design, scope, and prioritize experiments aimed at improving funnel and conversion performance
* Maintain visibility across all active site experiments — tracked, monitored, and read out consistently
* Generate and follow the data to propose UX and funnel testing that improves the quote and application experience

**Reporting \& Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a daily power user of dashboards (Power BI or similar), using them to understand funnel health, traffic performance, SEO/AEO, and experiment status at both a macro business level and a micro diagnostic level
* Leverage SQL, Snowflake, or similar platforms to construct BI reports and uncover digital conversion gaps
* Understand the martech stack, tagging, tracking, and data flows well enough to identify measurement gaps, partner on fixes, and ensure funnel reporting reflects how the customer experience actually works
* Communicate performance insights and recommendations clearly to leadership, translating technical findings into business\-ready narratives
* Act as a connector across Analytics, channel owners, Engineering, Creative, SEO/AEO, and Product Marketing to align insights, priorities, and optimization p

We're looking for a strategic, culturally plugged\-in Social Media Manager to join Spotify's Social team in New York. This breakdown of this role is 50% campaign, 30% platform strategy, and 20% corporate social comms.


The ideal candidate has led social campaigns end\-to\-end, has a sharp instinct for what works on each platform, and can move fluidly between managing a campaign war room and crafting a corporate comms post. You're immersed in culture, you understand how Gen Z and millennial audiences consume content, and you bring both creative ambition and operational rigor.

	+ Strong writing and editing skills with the ability to craft engaging copy across different platform voices and tones
	+ Video editing proficiency — you can turn raw coverage and campaign footage into polished recaps and social\-native content
	+ Experience managing agency and vendor relationships, including creative feedback and delivery workflows
	+ Sharp cultural instincts — you're always plugged into what's trending and understand how to make a brand part of the conversation
	+ Operational rigor — you can build and manage timelines, briefs, and cross\-functional workflows without dropping balls
	+ Comfortable working with senior leaders and cross\-functional partners across multiple priorities
	+ Experience with corporate or brand communications on social

Where You'll Be


* + This role is based in New York.
	+ We offer flexibility to work where you work best, with 2–3 days per week in the office. Collaboration hours align to the EST time zone.

jobs.description:
**A Better Built World**
------------------------


At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure \- roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.


For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on\-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.


That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.


This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double\-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M\+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

**About the Team \& How We Work:**
----------------------------------


Our SDR team is the engine behind Miter’s pipeline growth — and we’re scaling fast. As an Outbound SDR, you’ll own prospecting within a newly established geographic territory model, partnering closely with Account Executives to execute a targeted, scalable outbound strategy across the construction industry.


This is a builder’s seat. You’ll have room to get creative as we shape a repeatable SDR playbook and a high\-impact, data\-driven sales engine, working alongside sales, marketing, and leadership to test new ideas, sharpen messaging, and accelerate revenue growth.


As the first point of contact for many of our future customers, you’ll set the tone for strong, lasting relationships and help contractors see the value of modern, industry\-leading tools. And we’re committed to your growth: SDRs at Miter have a clear path into senior SDR roles, Account Executive positions, and beyond.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Drive net\-new pipeline through high\-volume outbound prospecting — 80–100 dials a day across cold calls, personalized emails, and LinkedIn outreach
* Research target accounts and key personas across the construction industry to craft relevant, tailored messaging that breaks into hard\-to\-reach accounts
* Communicate Miter’s value proposition and business impact, qualifying prospects and booking \~5 direct SALs per month for your aligned Account Executive
* Own the nurture of every prospect all the way through to a completed discovery call and a clean handoff to your AE
* Own your activity and pipeline metrics in Salesforce, and help build a repeatable playbook by testing and refining messaging, cadences, and scripts as we grow the team

**What You’ll Need:**

* No prior experience required — prior SDR work, cold calling, or outbound prospecting is a plus, along with athletic, competitive, or leadership experience

Wingspan is the AI\-native platform for the flexible workforce. Our agents run onboarding and verification, manage work and pay, bill and stay compliant, and support workers on one record, across 1099 contractors, international contractors, and flexible W\-2 employees.

jobs.title: Development Assistant
jobs.description:
**About Outright International**



Founded in 1990, Outright Action International strives to help lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, and queer (LGBTIQ) people live safer, healthier, and more empowered lives worldwide. With staff in 18 countries and global headquarters in New York City, Outright documents human rights violations, helps resource LGBTIQ movements and allies, and advocates for the rights of LGBTIQ people.

  

Reporting to the Director of Development, the Development Assistant is a key member of Outright's Development team, providing administrative and operational support across donor database management, fundraising operations, individual giving, events, and donor stewardship. The role works closely with the Senior Database Manager and the Director of Leadership Giving, and coordinates regularly with Finance, Operations, Communications, and external vendors. This role offers a strong foundation in nonprofit fundraising operations, donor systems, and donor engagement, within a collaborative, cross\-functional Development team.

  

The position is based in New York City with a hybrid schedule and regular in\-person responsibilities, including occasional evening and weekend work for donor events and occasional travel outside New York City.

 **Responsibilities**


*Gift Processing, Acknowledgement, and Database Management*


* Ensure the timely collection, opening, documentation, and processing of checks and other gifts received at Outright's offices, and communicate relevant information promptly to the Senior Database Manager and other relevant personnel.
* Accurately collect, deposit, record, and confirm donations of various sizes.
* Manage timely and accurate donor receipts and acknowledgements for gifts within an assigned range (e.g., $0–$2,499\), escalating higher\-level gifts as appropriate.
* Working closely with the Senior Database Manager, maintain, update, and ensure the accuracy of donor database records, including data entry, list segmentation, data cleanup, and database\-related projects.
* Maintain accurate information in Development's financial reconciliation tools and trackers, and support regular Development–Finance reconciliation processes and resolution of discrepancies.
* Maintain organized electronic and physical documentation related to gifts and donor records.
* Assist with monitoring online giving platforms and other incoming gift channels as assigned.
* Create fundraising reports and other donor/database reports as needed for frontline fundraisers and for email and direct mail marketing.
* Coordinate with the organization's state registration consultant to maintain charitable registration compliance across all required states.

  


*Administrative and Departmental Support*


* Provide administrative and clerical support to the Director of Development and the Director of Leadership Giving, including scheduling, contract processing, and other administrative tasks.
* Assist with Development calendars, trackers, project\-management systems, files, documentation, and other shared administrative resources.
* Help maintain data quality and consistency across Development systems, assist colleagues in navigating established processes, and help route more complex requests to the appropriate team member.
* Maintain documentation of recurring processes and contribute to improvements that make Development operations more efficient and effective.

  


*Individual Giving and Donor Communications*


* Assist with donor correspondence, mailings, digital appeals, acknowledgements, and other individual giving communications.
* Support maintenance of donor and prospect records, portfolios, lists, and activity tracking.
* Assist with direct mail, digital fundraising, and other individual giving campaigns, including administrative coordination with external vendors and consultants as requested.
* Provide administrative support for donor meetings, briefings, cultivation opportunities, and follow\-up.
* Assist with CRM\-based donor research and data.

  


*Events and Donor Engagement*


* Assemble donor materials, gift bags, and informational kits for events and meetings.
* Assist with in\-person and virtual event logistics, including the annual gala, donor events, and webinars — covering invitations, RSVP tracking, guest lists, registration, and materials development.
* Provide on\-site administrative support before, during, and following events, as required.
* Support post\-event data entry, reconciliation, gift acknowledgement, and data required for follow\-up communications.
* Other duties as assigned.

  


**Qualifications**


* 2\-5 years of professional experience working in a nonprofit, fundraising, or administrative setting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage detailed administrative work accurately and consistently.
* Proven ability to work efficiently and collaboratively with multiple stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and contribute as a committed team member.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and concisely.
* Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently while also collaborating as part of a small team.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a professional, positive demeanor.
* Ability to handle donor and organizational information with discretion and confidentiality.
* Knowledge of or demonstrated interest in LGBTIQ\+ issues, human rights, gender, international development, or related areas.
* Experience with donor databases, constituent relationship management systems, online fundraising platforms, and project\-management tools preferred (e.g., Fundraise Up, DonorPerfect, HubSpot, Monday.com, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom).
* Experience supporting direct mail, digital fundraising, donor communications, or individual giving programs is an asset.

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high\-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. Zivel Buckhead is looking for an organized, outgoing, and proactive **Wellness Operations \& Client Experience Coordinator** to help support the day\-to\-day operations of our growing wellness and recovery center.

We're looking for someone who can become an important part of the business — someone who enjoys working with customers, stays organized, follows through, takes initiative, and is comfortable wearing a few different hats in a growing environment.

You won't spend your entire day sitting behind a desk, and you won't spend your entire day selling.

You'll help make sure customers are taken care of, opportunities don't fall through the cracks, and the business stays organized and continues growing.

**Marketing \& Community Engagement**

* Develop relationships with local gyms, wellness professionals, apartment communities, businesses, and other potential referral partners.
* Assist with community events, networking opportunities, partnerships, and promotional activities.
* Help generate ideas for attracting new customers and keeping existing customers engaged.

Who We're Looking For

The right person doesn't necessarily need experience in every area above.

We're more interested in finding someone who is:

* Highly organized and dependable.
* Friendly and confident communicating with customers.
* Proactive and comfortable taking initiative.
* Strong at following through and keeping track of details.
* Comfortable working independently while also being part of a small team.
* Able to shift between customer\-facing responsibilities and administrative work.
* Comfortable using technology, email, social media, scheduling systems, and CRM software.

Experience in **wellness, fitness, healthcare, chiropractic, hospitality, customer service, office administration, executive/administrative support, membership\-based businesses, or small\-business operations** would be especially valuable.

Experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Canva, CRM systems, email marketing, scheduling software, or social media is a plus.

The Person Who Will Thrive Here

We're looking for someone who notices what needs to be done and helps get it done.

You might be a great fit if you're the person who naturally keeps things organized, remembers the follow\-up everyone else forgot, communicates well with customers, enjoys solving problems, and likes helping a growing business run more smoothly.

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful role in the growth of a local wellness business rather than being limited to one narrow responsibility.

Compensation

**$33,280–$37,440 per year, based on experience, plus a competitive performance\-based bonus structure.**

The base compensation is separate from the bonus opportunity.

Additional bonuses may be earned based on measurable contributions to areas such as new customers, memberships, appointments, referrals, partnerships, customer retention, and overall business growth.

Zivel Buckhead is a wellness and recovery center helping people feel, perform, and recover better through services including cryotherapy, infrared sauna, float therapy, red light therapy, compression, and other innovative wellness and recovery solutions.

The Concierge Account Manager is a field\-based operations leadership role responsible for supervising, scaling, and standardizing concierge\-style security operations across multiple client locations. The role owns service quality, post order compliance, staffing stability, training consistency, and client satisfaction across the assigned concierge portfolio.


The Security Concierge Account Manager serves as the primary leader for onsite Concierge Leads and ensures every site operates consistently through coaching, audits, performance management, and strong client relationships.


During the initial launch and pilot phase of the division, this position is expected to actively work onsite at varying locations approximately one to two days per week to support process mapping, operational design, training execution, and service standard implementation. Following successful scale and operational consistency within the Atlanta market, the position will transition into a more traditional field operations account management structure with oversight responsibilities focused exclusively on concierge clients and teams.

* **Concierge Leadership Across Multiple Sites:** Own day\-to\-day execution and performance across the concierge security portfolio. Establish operational standards for appearance, customer experience, access control, reporting quality, and professionalism. Ensure each site maintains clear coverage plans, escalation procedures, and shift leadership consistency. Drive operational accountability and service excellence across locations.
* **Leadership \& Team Development:** Lead and manage onsite Security Concierge Leads as direct reports. Hold leaders accountable to measurable performance expectations and operational standards. Deliver coaching, recognition, corrective action, and performance management when appropriate. Conduct recurring check\-ins and maintain documented action plans and follow\-up. Ensure leads effectively train and develop their teams beyond routine site visits.
* **Quality Assurance \& Compliance:** Conduct scheduled and surprise site audits to ensure post order compliance. Review daily activity reports, incident reports, operational logs, and site documentation. Identify recurring concerns and implement corrective action plans with ownership and timelines. Ensure licensing and compliance requirements are consistently maintained.

jobs.description:
**\*\*BILINGUAL CANDIDATES PREFERRED\*\***

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**


Asset Living is a third\-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single\-family home rentals, affordable housing, build\-to\-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.  



  

Asset Living is a fast\-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.  



  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for overseeing, under the supervision of the Community Manager, the everyday operations and financial functions of the housing community. As the Assistant Community Manager, you will play a vital role in the delinquency and collection of rent to optimize the property's cash flow and financial position. As an Assistant Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration \& risk management in the absence of the Community Manager. As an onsite leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with the company's policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

 **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**

  

Financial Management

* Responsible for posting all payments and income received from all applicants, current residents, and non\-current residents accurately, timely, and efficiently.
* Responsible for processing and reconciling daily all account receivables.
* Monitor and follow up on bad debt to include preparation of late notices, resident and guarantor contact, and filing evictions.
* Responsible for helping the property meet budgeted revenues, expenses, and Net Operating Income.
* Responsible for posting of all charges to resident and non\-current resident accounts; to also include bill back of utilities where applicable.
* Responsible for all end\-of\-the\-month closing procedures and reporting.
* Maintain accurate and organized records; audit resident files to ensure accurate records.
* Responsible for walking units and posting all move\-out charges, statements, and security deposit refunds.

  

Personnel Management

* Use consistent techniques \& company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop onsite staff.
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership.
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures.
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow\-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Implement marketing strategies \& systems put in place by the annual marketing plan.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction.
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents.

  

Administrative Management

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Assist with supervision of all business functions related to operations.
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)

 **Education/Experience**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred or two years experience in the housing industry; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Ability to understand and perform all onsite software functions; basic computer skills required.
* Must have basic knowledge of Fair Housing Laws and OSHA requirements.

**Digital Marketing Specialist** to boost our online presence, generate inbound leads, and customer outreach. jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**  

We are seeking a **Business Development Representative – Stone \& Cabinet** to drive new business growth by developing customer relationships, reactivating dormant accounts, and expanding market presence in the field. This role is ideal for a sales professional who is strong in prospecting, customer visits, relationship building, and converting small or occasional purchases into stable monthly business. Experience in stone, cabinets, kitchen \& bath, or related building materials is preferred.

 **About Us**



BCS Stone \& Cabinets Inc. serves local and regional customers with integrated stone and cabinetry solutions for residential and commercial projects. Backed by the broader Best Cheer platform, our business benefits from vertically integrated sourcing, manufacturing, and supply capabilities built since 1994\.



We support fabricators, builders, contractors, remodelers, dealers, distributors, and other trade customers with slabs, prefabricated countertops, vanity tops, tiles, mosaics, façade panels, cut\-to\-size products, and cabinetry solutions. With factory\-direct advantages, strong inventory support, competitive pricing, and responsive service, we help our customers source efficiently, stay competitive, and keep projects moving.

 **Why Choose BCS?**


* **Fast Fulfillment**: Many orders placed before 12 PM can ship the same day, helping our sales team respond quickly and win business.
* **Sales Advantage:** Factory\-direct pricing, strong inventory support, and broad product selection help our field sales team compete effectively and close business faster.
* **Global Powerhouse:** Work for a leader with 30 years of history and the country’s largest inventory of prefabricated stone and cabinetry.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Prospect and develop new business opportunities with fabricators, contractors, builders, remodelers, and other target customers in the local and surrounding markets.
* Reactivate dormant accounts and turn inactive customers into recurring purchasing accounts.
* Conduct regular field visits, customer meetings, and jobsite visits to expand market coverage and strengthen customer relationships.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers by understanding their project needs, buying cycles, and product requirements.
* Promote BCS stone and cabinet products by presenting product advantages, pricing value, delivery speed, and inventory support.
* Convert small or occasional purchases into stable repeat business by increasing order frequency, customer retention, and share of wallet.
* Follow up consistently on customer inquiries, samples, quotes, and open opportunities to move prospects through the sales pipeline and close business.
* Identify new sales opportunities through cold outreach, referrals, market visits, trade relationships, and account development efforts.
* Coordinate with design support, operations, and management to ensure accurate quoting, design follow\-through when needed, smooth order execution, and strong customer satisfaction.
* Develop and manage a portfolio of self\-generated accounts, building long\-term customer relationships and driving repeat business growth.
* Maintain organized records of customer visits, pipeline status, account activity, and sales progress, and provide regular updates on market feedback and business opportunities.


**Qualifications**


* ***2\+ years of experience in outside sales, business development, field sales, or account acquisition.***
* Proven ability to prospect, develop new customers, and grow sales through relationship\-based selling.
* Strong communication, follow\-up, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage a sales territory, and maintain a consistent customer visit schedule.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with customers and business partners.
* Experience in stone, cabinets, kitchen \& bath, building materials, or related industries is preferred.
* Existing relationships with fabricators, contractors, builders, remodelers, or related trade customers are a plus.
* Ability to read basic blueprints, measurements, or project layouts is preferred.
* Valid Georgia driver’s license, good driving record, and ability to be added to the company’s vehicle insurance, if required.
* ***Bilingual in Spanish, Russian or Chinese is preferred.***
* ***Experience with 2020 Design or similar cabinet design software is a plus.***
* Ability to occasionally work weekends, attend customer events, or travel within the assigned market, if needed.

  


**Compensation \& Benefits**


* Base salary of $46,000 plus uncapped commission. Typical first\-year earnings are expected to reach $55,000–$100,000\+.
* **Zero\-Threshold Commission:** Earn commission on your very first sale from Day 1—no minimum quota required.
* **Car \& Travel Allowance:** Business mileage reimbursement or company car with fuel expense coverage.
* **Retirement:** 401(k) with 3% Company Match
* **Insurance:** Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans.
* **Time Off:** 10 days of PTO in the first year plus Paid Holidays.

  


**Working Conditions**  

Multiple environments including office and warehouse.

  


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



Best Cheer Stone is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Belgard Sales Representative (Hardscapes)
jobs.description:
Job ID: 528505

  

Oldcastle, a CRH company, is reinventing what's possible in building solutions. We are the leading provider of innovative outdoor living products and utility infrastructure solutions for the water, energy, and communications markets throughout North America. We're a trusted and strategic partner to engineers, contractors, distributors, specifiers, retailers, and homeowners alike as the manufacturer of precast concrete, polymer concrete, and plastic infrastructure products. Our portfolio of brands includes Oldcastle APG, Oldcastle Infrastructure, Belgard® hardscape, Echelon® Masonry, RDI® railing, Catalyst™ Fence Solutions, Sakrete® packaged concrete, Amerimix® mortar, Pebble Technology International® pool finishes, and Techniseal® sands and sealant technologies.  



**Job Summary**

  

Oldcastle APG is seeking a results\-driven, relationship\-oriented Belgard Sales Representative to join our high\-performing team in the Northwest Georgia Metro region. In this pivotal role, you’ll take the lead on growing and maintaining a multi\-million\-dollar territory—serving as a trusted advisor to customers, contractors, and dealers. You’ll have the autonomy to build your own success while backed by the strength, innovation, and support of a national industry leader.

  

As a Belgard Sales Representative, you’ll be the face of our brand—managing existing customer relationships, uncovering new business opportunities, and helping clients bring their outdoor visions to life. You’ll leverage your knowledge of the construction or building materials industry to drive results in a competitive, fast\-paced environment.

 **Job Location**

  

* This position is remote, and this person needs to live in Northwest Georgia.
 **Job Responsibilities**

  

* Grow and Maintain Customer Relationships \- Build trust with existing customers, understand their evolving needs, and increase sales through service excellence and strategic insight.
* Prospect and Develop New Business \- Identify new leads, engage prospective customers, and expand Belgard’s footprint in the region through proactive outreach and innovative selling techniques.
* Strategize for Success \- Collaborate with contractors and dealers to craft tailored sales strategies that meet client goals and market demands.
* Stay Ahead of Market Trends \- Analyze local and regional market dynamics to stay competitive and capitalize on new opportunities.
* Be Data\-Driven \- Prepare sales reports, track prospecting activities, and translate dealer sales data into actionable insights that support smarter production planning.
* Close with Confidence \- Provide accurate quotes, credit terms, and formalize sales contracts, ensuring clarity and alignment with client expectations.
* Adapt and Collaborate \- Perform related duties and contribute to company success as needed, across sales, logistics, and customer service functions.

 **Job Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in sales, business, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience managing multi\-million\-dollar sales territory, ideally in building materials or construction industries.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals in a territory\-based role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills—you’re just as comfortable presenting to executives as you are speaking with contractors.
* Strong understanding of CRM systems and sales reporting tools.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel overnight as needed.
* Willingness to lift products up to 50 lbs. during demonstrations or events.
* Home office required – this is a field\-based role with a lot of time spent on the road.
* Bilingual in Spanish and English to better serve a diverse customer base. (preferred)

 **Compensation**

  

* Base Salary $40,000\-$45,000 plus commissions, annual earnings between $100,000\-$110,000
* Monthly car allowance
* 401(k) plan / group retirement savings program
* Short\-term and long\-term disability benefits
* Life insurance
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays
 **What CRH Offers You**

  

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

  

**About CRH**

  

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.

  

If you’re up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!

  



Oldcastle APG, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.

CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

**WG Waste LLC** is a growing, family\-owned commercial waste and recycling company seeking a **driven, self\-motivated Sales Lead** to help grow our business.

jobs.description:
**Supply \& Logistics Coordinator**  

**Reports to:** Vice President of Fuels  

**Department:** Fuels / Supply \& Logistics  

  

**Position Summary**  

The Supply \& Logistics Coordinator is responsible for supporting daily fuel supply, logistics, inventory management, reporting, and cost analysis for Road Ranger Travel Centers and potential wholesale customers. This role works closely with suppliers, terminals, common carriers, third\-party logistics providers, internal operations, and the Vice President of Fuels to ensure reliable supply, accurate reporting, efficient deliveries, and cost\-effective fuel sourcing.  

The position also supports ERP/PDI system accuracy, supplier pricing analysis, nightly supply sourcing in a team rotation, executive reporting, and special projects as assigned.  

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities*** Reconcile, analyze, and report daily fuel activity for Road Ranger Travel Centers.
* Develop and maintain weekly and monthly fuel accounting, inventory, logistics, and cost reports.
* Schedule, coordinate, and monitor fuel deliveries for Road Ranger locations and wholesale customers.
* Manage communication and performance coordination with suppliers, terminals, common carriers, and third\-party logistics providers.
* Reconcile and proof carrier freight charges for payment processing documenting deductions due to inaccurate billing and track carrier performance.
* Monitor inventory levels, demand trends, and supply availability to support timely fuel ordering and delivery execution.
* Coordinate and secure fuel supply at various terminals.
* Participate in nightly supply sourcing as part of a Monday through Friday team rotation.
* Assist the Vice President of Fuels with product sourcing, supplier pricing analysis, fuel cost reporting, and supply strategy.
* Support ERP/PDI system setup, improvements, data entry, and ongoing system accuracy.
* Prepare analytics, dashboards, and PowerPoint presentations related to fuel cost, inventory, supplier pricing, logistics performance, and operational activity.
* Support executive\-level and board\-level reporting and presentations as needed.
* Perform special projects and other departmental duties as assigned.
* Maintain confidentiality of company pricing, supply, logistics, and financial information.

**Schedule Requirements**  

Monday through Friday, in\-office, from **1pm to 10p.m.** with some remote working from home optionality. This position also requires participation in nightly supply sourcing rotation. Weekend rotation managing Road Ranger fuels inventory, delivery forecasting, order creation and delivery amendments, and on call for supply issues and common carrier support,  

  

**Education \& Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Logistics, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, transportation, fuel supply, or related operations.
* Experience in general accounting, financial reporting, reconciliation, and business analysis in a corporate environment preferred.
* Experience with ERP systems, PDI, inventory systems, or fuel management platforms preferred.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications*** Strong organizational skills with strict attention to detail.
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple competing deadlines.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Expert proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Strong PowerPoint slide creation skills, including executive\-level and board\-level presentation development.
* Strong data analytics skills, including excel analysis, Power BI, dashboards, reporting, and trend analysis.
* Comfortable presenting analytics, findings, and recommendations to leadership and board\-level audiences.
* Proficient creating, utilizing, analyzing spread sheets, pivot tables V look up, databases, reporting tools, and presentation software effectively.
* Flexible, process\-oriented, and able to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* High degree of confidentiality, professionalism, and accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Fuel supply, petroleum, terminal, or common carrier logistics experience.
* Experience with PDI or other fuel accounting/inventory management systems.
* Knowledge of fuel pricing, rack pricing, freight costs, inventory levels, and delivery scheduling.
* Experience supporting wholesale fuel customers or multi\-site retail fuel operations.

**Position Objective**  

The Supply \& Logistics Coordinator supports reliable fuel supply, accurate inventory levels, efficient logistics execution, supplier and carrier coordination, and cost\-effective fuel operations across Road Ranger Travel Centers and wholesale fuel customers.  

Road Ranger is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status or civil partnership/union status, veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy, genetic information, physical or mental disability, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

jobs.description:
Studios Marketing Agency is looking for an organized, proactive and personable **Part\-Time Partnerships \& Operations Coordinator** to support our growing client roster and founder.

This is a unique hybrid role combining partnership coordination, business development support and light founder/operational assistance. We're looking for someone who loves taking a lot of moving pieces and turning them into a clear plan, keeping conversations moving and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

You'll work closely with the founder of Studios and serve as a point of contact for select client partnerships, helping move opportunities from initial conversation through execution.

**What You'll Do**

**Partnerships \+ Client Coordination**

* Attend select partnership and event\-planning calls on behalf of Studios and our clients
* Communicate with brands, vendors, influencers and local businesses
* Gather pricing, availability, deliverables and event details
* Send follow\-ups and keep partnership conversations moving
* Maintain an organized tracker of active and prospective partnerships
* Turn calls and conversations into clear action items, owners and deadlines
* Coordinate partnership and event logistics
* Create detailed event briefs for Studios' Events \& Content Coordinators
* Ensure event contacts, expectations, timing and content needs are communicated before activations
* Follow up after events and close outstanding loops

**Business Development Support**

* Research prospective Studios clients and relevant decision\-makers
* Build and maintain prospect lists
* Support approved outbound outreach
* Manage follow\-up cadence with prospective clients
* Maintain lead statuses within Studios' CRM and/or Notion
* Flag warm opportunities for the founder
* Help make sure potential new business never falls through the cracks

The founder will continue to lead discovery calls, proposals, pricing and closing conversations.

**Operations \+ Founder Support**

* Review meeting notes and organize action items within Notion
* Maintain clear client and founder priority lists
* Track deadlines and outstanding follow\-ups
* Draft routine emails and communications
* Assist with miscellaneous administrative needs as they arise
* Identify open loops before they become missed deadlines

**What This Role Does Not Own**

This position will not independently determine Studios pricing, contracts, scope changes, high\-level client strategy, financial decisions or significant client\-conflict resolution. Those decisions remain with Studios leadership.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You...

* Are **extremely organized** and naturally follow through
* Can turn a 30\-minute conversation into a beautifully organized action plan
* Communicate confidently and professionally via email and on calls
* Are comfortable representing Studios with clients, partners and vendors
* Take ownership without needing constant direction
* Have strong written communication skills
* Understand social media and modern marketing
* Are comfortable using or learning Notion, Google Workspace and CRM/outreach tools
* Can manage multiple small projects simultaneously
* Are comfortable working directly with a founder in a fast\-moving agency environment

Marketing, PR, events, hospitality, agency or partnership experience is a plus, but strong organization, initiative and communication skills matter most.

**Hours \+ Commitment**

This is a **variable part\-time position averaging approximately 5–10 hours per week.**

Hours may fluctuate depending on client partnership activity, events and business\-development needs. Some weeks may be closer to five hours, while busier weeks may approach 10\.

Most work can be completed remotely and flexibly, but availability for occasional scheduled calls during standard business hours is required.

Chicago\-area candidates are preferred, although we are open to the right remote candidate.

**Compensation**

**$25–$28/hour based on experience**, with the opportunity for responsibilities and hours to grow alongside Studios.

**About Studios Marketing Agency**

Studios Marketing Agency is a full\-service marketing agency built to operate as an extension of our clients' teams. We work across social media, content creation, brand strategy, partnerships, events, digital marketing, websites and more.

We're a small, growing team, which means this role offers hands\-on exposure to multiple brands, direct collaboration with the founder and an opportunity to meaningfully shape how our internal partnership and business\-development processes grow.

Please submit your resume along with a brief note answering:

* Why does this role interest you?

The Recruiting Coordinator is responsible for coordinating interviews, supporting onboarding activities, maintaining applicant tracking system data, and assisting with recruitment initiatives while ensuring compliance with company policies and employment regulations. * Coordinate pre\-employment activities, including background checks, drug screenings, reference checks, and new hire paperwork.
