new_jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**  

Bobyard uses AI to take contractors from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. We're Series A backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear ($35M — 2x the median raise), and our customers are running real construction jobs on Bobyard right now, not sitting through a demo.

 **About the Role**  

Implementation Specialist runs the day\-to\-day work of getting new mid\-market customers live and trained on Bobyard. We're building this role because launch quality can't scale on ad hoc effort — someone needs to own kickoff calls, configuration, and training as a repeatable motion, at volume. You'll win when a customer's team is actually using Bobyard on real jobs, not just logged in, and when you can run that outcome across a full book of accounts every month, not just one at a time.

 **What You'll Do**

* Run kickoff calls and configure new mid\-market accounts so they're ready to go within days of signature, not weeks
* Deliver hands\-on training that gets real crews — estimators, PMs, field staff — actually using Bobyard, not just clicking through a demo
* Own a high\-volume book of concurrent launches and keep every one of them moving without dropping details
* Run repeatable training sessions and office hours, refining the curriculum as you see what actually lands with users
* Catch stragglers early — flag accounts that are stalling before they quietly go dark
* Document account context well enough that Customer Success can pick it up cold with zero re\-explaining
* Feed real, specific product and training feedback back to Product and Customer Success

 **What We're Looking For**

* 2\+ years in a customer\-facing SaaS role — onboarding, implementation, training, or customer success
* Comfortable running live training for non\-technical or field\-based users, not just technical buyers
* Can juggle a high\-volume portfolio of accounts at once without losing the thread on any of them
* Clear, concrete written communication — your notes are why the next person never has to ask what happened
* Hands\-on with software yourself — you configure things, you don't wait on someone else to do it
* Genuinely energized by construction, trades, or other real\-world industries
* No SaaS background required if you've got the industry instead — if you've run estimates, managed jobs, or worked the trades and want to move into tech, you'll pick this up fast

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience in vertical SaaS or construction tech
* Familiarity with CRM or onboarding tooling (Salesforce, Asana, Notion)
* Prior experience in construction, estimating, or the trades
* Bilingual (Spanish or otherwise) — useful with field crews

 **What We Offer**
  

  

$85,000–$110,000 base salary, plus equity. Based in San Francisco, on\-site with the team at 101 2nd Street.

 **Comp Philosophy**

We are proud to offer competitive, top\-of\-market compensation because we want to celebrate the dedicated people who ship amazing work and drive our success. Our individual compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on your role, experience, and contributions, alongside performance\-based rewards.


Compensation Range: $85K \- $100K

new_jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
**Strategy \& Operations Associate**

**San Francisco, CA: Financial District. In\-Person (M\-F)**

We are very excited to be hiring our first Strategy \& Operations (BizOps) Associate. You'll go wherever the operation is breaking, scope the problem, build the fix, and hand it off. And you'll do it AI\-natively — we expect the person in this seat to replace manual work with agents and internal tooling rather than absorb it as headcount. How we run ourselves internally should look like the product we sell: it's part of our advantage, not back\-office overhead.


Finance operations and reporting are the anchor — the numbers, the close, the board deck, the dashboard everyone actually looks at — but the role doesn't stop at Finance. You'll sit at the center of the company, supporting both sides of the org: GTM (sales, marketing, product, customer success) and Engineering \& Design. You'll work directly with the founders and every function lead here. Most of what you'll own doesn't exist yet — you'll be the one who builds it.


No two weeks look the same, and that's the point. You'll report to the Chief of Staff and rotate across finance operations, GTM reporting, and eng/design operations — owning real work in each, not observing. The scope is wide because the company moves fast and the problems don't respect org charts. This role is for someone genuinely comfortable with ambiguity \- scopes shifts week to week.

**Why FurtherAI?**

* **Elite Team \& Culture:** Join a YC and a16z\-backed startup, collaborating with industry experts who share your hunger and ambition. Be part of a culture built for high performers who are proud to put in the work.
* **Transformative Opportunity:** Sell pioneering AI solutions in complex, regulated industries and help modernize a trillion\-dollar sector.
* **Leadership Growth:** Leverage your experience to shape our sales process and grow into a senior leadership role as the company scales.
* **Highly Competitive Compensation:** Strong base salary, top\-tier commission plan, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

**What You'll Do**

* **Put AI to work inside FurtherAI.** Find the work people are doing that AI should be doing instead. Build AI workflows and internal tooling that eliminate manual steps across finance and ops, and become the person the team comes to for what's worth automating and how.
* **Support FinOps and cost discipline.** Track infrastructure and vendor costs, pull the analysis that shows where the money is going, flag what looks off, and support the work to bring it down.
* **Build the reporting the company runs on.** Create and maintain the KPI dashboards, board materials, and recurring reports leadership actually uses to make decisions — revenue, pipeline, burn, headcount, and beyond.
* **Support GTM.** Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product and Customer Success on pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and the data and materials they need to hit the number.
* **Support Engineering \& Design.** Partner with Engineering and Design on headcount and hiring plans, tooling, and the operational rhythm that keeps a fast\-moving product org organized.
* **Run cross\-functional projects end to end.** Pricing analyses, market sizing, competitive research, fundraising prep, or whatever ambiguous work doesn't belong to any one team — you scope it, run it, and land it, working with the COO/Chief of Staff to prioritize what matters most this week.
* **Own the mechanics of money moving in and out.** Vendor onboarding and payments, customer invoicing, billing accuracy, collections follow\-up, and expense workflows, plus the monthly close, cash tracking, and budget\-vs\-actuals. Turn what lives in someone's inbox into a process that runs on its own.

**Who You Are**

* You've been the best at something — top of your class, captain of the team, first in your cohort — and you're looking for the next thing to pour that into.
* At every past job you ended up doing more than your title said.
* You have a builder's instinct for process — when something breaks twice, you redesign it; when a task eats four hours every week, you make it run itself.
* You're as comfortable in a spreadsheet or financial model as you are in a room with Sales or Engineering.
* You get energy from moving fast across many problems, not sitting in one lane.
* You'd rather own a messy problem end\-to\-end than execute a clean task someone handed you.
* You context\-switch without losing intensity, and you care about outcomes over job descriptions.

**Requirements**

* 2–4\+ years in a high\-paced environment \- MBB, Investment Banking, or similar required.
* Genuinely AI\-native — you already use LLMs and agents as leverage in your own work and have built things with them, not just used a chatbot to draft an email.
* Strong financial and analytical skills — comfortable building and stress\-testing a model, not just reading one, and pulling your own numbers without waiting on someone else.
* Extremely high attention to detail — this role touches money moving in and out of the company, and small errors are expensive.
* Strong written and verbal communication across Finance, GTM, and Engineering — you can write a crisp update, chase an overdue invoice professionally, and explain a process to someone with no context.
* Bias toward action; based in San Francisco or willing to relocate immediately.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in Insurtech, Fintech, etc, or B2B SaaS at a high\-growth technology company.
* Hands\-on experience with financial systems (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Ramp, Rippling, or similar) and BI/reporting or internal\-tooling platforms (Looker, Retool, Sigma, Zapier, or similar).
* Prior startup or founder experience.
* Exposure to sales/GTM operations and/or engineering program management.

**You can look forward to the following benefits:**

* Fully covered, best\-in\-class health, dental, and vision benefits
* Competitive Compensation, meaningful stock options, company 401(k)
* Unli

new_jobs.title: Order and Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Job Title: Order and Production Coordinator  
Company: Indigo Promotions  
Location: North Bergen, NJ, In Person  
Job Type: Full Time  
Experience Level: Entry Level  
Compensation: $18\.00 to $20\.00 per hour

About Indigo Promotions:

Indigo Promotions is a minority\-owned branded merchandise company that creates custom products, apparel, packaging, event giveaways, and corporate gifting programs for leading global brands. We manage creative, deadline\-driven projects through domestic suppliers, overseas factories, and our in\-house production capabilities.

Position Overview:

Indigo Promotions is seeking an organized, dependable, and highly detail\-oriented Order and Production Coordinator to join our team.

This is an entry\-level position with hands\-on training provided. You will learn how to create purchase orders, communicate with suppliers and factories, monitor production schedules, review order details, and help ensure projects are completed accurately and delivered on time.

The goal is for this person to gradually take ownership of the production coordination process for an assigned group of clients. No promotional products experience is required, but you must be organized, comfortable following detailed processes, and willing to take responsibility for keeping projects on track.

Responsibilities:

* Create purchase orders with accurate pricing, quantities, product specifications, artwork instructions, shipping information, and delivery dates.
* Communicate regularly with domestic suppliers and overseas factories to request updates and keep orders moving.
* Monitor production schedules and confirm that projects remain on track for their required delivery dates.
* Request and organize virtual proofs, product samples, production photos, tracking information, and shipping documents.
* Carefully review purchase orders, proofs, and production details for accuracy before orders move forward.
* Track projects from the time an order is placed through production, shipping, and final delivery.
* Keep CommonSku and internal project trackers updated with accurate order information.
* Notify the team immediately about potential delays, inventory problems, artwork concerns, or production issues.
* Help coordinate solutions when an order encounters a production or shipping problem.
* Maintain clear records of factory conversations, approvals, deadlines, and project updates.
* Learn Indigo Promotions’ production procedures and gradually take ownership of assigned orders and client projects.
* Assist with estimates, sales orders, invoices, and client presentations when needed.
* Handle additional production and operational responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications and Skills:

* This is an entry\-level position, and previous promotional products or production experience is not required.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to review information carefully.
* Excellent organization and time\-management skills.
* Clear and professional written communication.
* Ability to follow established procedures while learning when to ask questions or escalate an issue.
* Comfortable managing several assignments and deadlines at the same time.
* Dependable, responsive, and willing to follow through until a task is completed.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities may change.
* Basic proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Docs.
* Willingness to learn CommonSku and other order\-management tools.
* Experience in customer service, administration, purchasing, logistics, project coordination, or order processing is helpful but not required.
* Experience communicating with vendors or working across international time zones is a plus.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn from feedback.

Training and Growth:

The Order and Production Coordinator will receive hands\-on training in Indigo Promotions’ systems, supplier relationships, order\-management procedures, and production processes.

The successful candidate will begin by supporting existing production workflows and learning alongside an experienced team member. As their knowledge and confidence grow, they will be expected to independently manage purchase orders, supplier communication, production schedules, and delivery tracking for assigned projects.

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.
Are you a strategic, clinically savvy sales professional passionate about driving meaningful impact in vascular care? Join us as an **Arterial Account Manager**, where you’ll operate with autonomy, lead program development, and partner with top physicians and health system leaders to bring life‑changing PAD and CLTI therapies to more patients.


In this high‑visibility role, you’ll collaborate across specialties—including interventionalists, vascular surgeons, service line leadership, and internal cross‑functional teams—to develop, launch, and scale PAD and LimFlow programs. You will also work closely with local Account Managers and Field Clinical Specialists to accelerate adoption and drive growth.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify new growth opportunities and uncover unmet clinical needs within PAD and CLTI patient populations.
* Build alignment with multidisciplinary stakeholders, including physician champions and hospital leadership.
* Drive therapy adoption through clinical expertise, education, and program‑building initiatives.
* Create demand and expand access to the Artix and LimFlow portfolios to grow long‑term franchise value.
* Execute coordinated strategies with VTE Account Managers using shared targets, aligned messaging, and real\-time field insights.
* Deliver high‑impact presentations outlining clinical and financial benefits of the portfolio to physicians and hospital administration.
* Provide valuable product feedback to R\&D and Marketing, serving as a key clinical voice for innovation.
* Represent the company at trade shows, conferences, and educational events.
* Act as a clinical subject matter expert during national calls and training programs.
* Partner with Sales Leadership and Medical Education to support new hire onboarding and ongoing training needs.
* Develop and disseminate insights to internal stakeholders during pre‑sale and evaluation processes.
* Perform other responsibilities as needed to support regional and national initiatives.

**What You Bring**

**Skills \& Abilities**

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong MS Office skills (PowerPoint, Excel, reporting).
* Exceptional presentation skills—from 1:1 settings to large audiences.
* Clinical excellence and comfort in case‑based environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Proven leadership and the ability to educate and develop others.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Passion for delivering patient‑focused, team‑based healthcare solutions.
* Robust sales and business acumen.
* Strong communication habits using company systems and tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science degree in a related field.
* Minimum 6 years of medical device field sales experience.
* Current certifications and vendor credentials.
* Demonstrated history of consistent quota attainment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* At least **2 years of experience with Stryker or Inari** sales/clinical (preferred).
* Previous experience in the **peripheral arterial space**.

**Why This Role Matters**


This is a unique opportunity to shape programs, lead strategic initiatives, and be at the forefront of innovation in PAD and CLTI care. If you thrive in clinically oriented environments, love building partnerships, and want to make a lasting impact on patient outcomes — we’d love to talk.

  

Base \+ commission: $125,000\.00 and may be eligible to earn commission and/or bonuses \+ benefits.


Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD\&D insurance, and short\-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI\-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000\+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer\-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.


Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.


Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.


At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We’re customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

  

As a Confirmed Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.


By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.


This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota\-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross\-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add\-on SKUs, and build deep, long\-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.


Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market\-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.


**This is a hybrid role based in NYC.**


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Own NRR: Manage the full post\-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
* Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
* Target Strategically: Prioritize high\-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long\-term growth plans.
* Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
* Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi\-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision\-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
* Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head\-to\-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
* Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
* Manage Pipeline \& Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data\-driven NRR forecasting.
* Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

* Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
* Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
* Customer\-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.

* Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long\-term value through partnership.
* Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next\-generation AI\-powered communications platform.

===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. * Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions

* 3\-5\+ years of account management or customer success experience in SaaS

* Strong history of retention and expansion revenue

At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure \- roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.


For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on\-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.


That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.


This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double\-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M\+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

----------------------------------


Our SDR team is the engine behind Miter’s pipeline growth — and we’re scaling fast. As an Outbound SDR, you’ll own prospecting within a newly established geographic territory model, partnering closely with Account Executives to execute a targeted, scalable outbound strategy across the construction industry.


This is a builder’s seat. You’ll have room to get creative as we shape a repeatable SDR playbook and a high\-impact, data\-driven sales engine, working alongside sales, marketing, and leadership to test new ideas, sharpen messaging, and accelerate revenue growth.


As the first point of contact for many of our future customers, you’ll set the tone for strong, lasting relationships and help contractors see the value of modern, industry\-leading tools. * Drive net\-new pipeline through high\-volume outbound prospecting — 80–100 dials a day across cold calls, personalized emails, and LinkedIn outreach
* Research target accounts and key personas across the construction industry to craft relevant, tailored messaging that breaks into hard\-to\-reach accounts
* Communicate Miter’s value proposition and business impact, qualifying prospects and booking \~5 direct SALs per month for your aligned Account Executive
* Own the nurture of every prospect all the way through to a completed discovery call and a clean handoff to your AE

* Self\-motivated and coachable, with a genuine desire to build a long\-term career in Sales
* A true team player above all — you win as a team and lift up the people around you

* **Learning \& Development:** We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development.
* **Office Extras:** Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in\-office Mitosaurs.

If you live within a reasonable commute to either our New York City or San Francisco offices, we ask that you work in our hybrid approach.

In today's economy, an increasing number of workers are choosing to freelance. By 2027, half the U.S. workforce will be independent contractors. A new paradigm is needed to accommodate the future of work that is suddenly no longer in the future. That is what Wingspan is building.



Wingspan is the AI\-native platform for the flexible workforce. Our agents run onboarding and verification, manage work and pay, bill and stay compliant, and support workers on one record, across 1099 contractors, international contractors, and flexible W\-2 employees.



We're a Series B startup based in NYC with backing from some of the best VCs and operators around, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Touring Capital, and the CEOs and founders of Warby Parker, Harry's, Allbirds, Invision, and Flatiron Health.

new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Facilities
new_jobs.description:
The purpose of the project coordinator position is to assist the project manager(s) by providing project support in key areas including assisting in project design; establishing project documentation; maintaining and/or establishing vendor contracts using the Supply Chain process; processing project invoices and monitoring project budget variances. Additionally, the project coordinator may provide project oversight in absence of the project manager. The project coordinator will also manage smaller projects, usually less than 2 – 3 week duration, including managing vendors, customer expectation and the project budget. The project coordinator acts as the department’s SharePoint administrator to ensure all project documentation is scanned and filed appropriately. Strong emphasis is placed on providing a positive response to the concerns and needs of the customer.  



Job Responsibilities  



**Functional Expertise:**

* Manages small projects (usually less than 2\-3 week duration) such as paving or roof repairs/replacements or replacement of mechanical equipment.
* Assists project manager(s) by coordinating proper vendor contracts with Supply Chain to ensure compliance
* Assist project manager(s) by monitoring project spend against established budget and report accrual(s) and appropriate documentation to Accounting, when necessary
* Performs cost analysis and itemizes project budget before composing AFE documentation and submitting for approval;
* Assemble, organize and maintain electronic project documentation via the department’s SharePoint site for future reference

**Business Acumen:**

* Stays abreast of relevant business priorities and changes, and how they affect day to day operations.
* Applies technical knowledge and business experience to solve operational challenges while identifying and escalating appropriate obstacles and issues to project manager.
* Work closely with procurement to develop and evaluate RFP’s that bring strategic partnerships that are competitive in price and present high service levels.

**Engagement:**

* Assists project manager by coordinating large moves outside of headquarters buildings. Coordinates with appropriate management team for optimum move plan.
* Maintains positive relationships with customers and vendors.
* Provides input to management with regards to how projects might affect daily operations, processes or procedures.
* Possesses good verbal and written communication and presentation skills. Is able to express ideas in a clear and concise manner to different levels within the organization.
* Conducts affairs with honesty, integrity, and respect when associating with others, and values the ideas, knowledge, and expertise of others.

**Driving Results** :


* Monitors against metrics and deliverables, holding self and others (vendors) accountable for results.
* Identifies and drives process improvement initiatives, including value engineering items in our construction projects.
* Ensures internal controls are achieved in compliance with corporate policies, procedures and standards.
* Tracks and reports changes that have been identified as having the ability to cause variances in overall project budget.

Qualifications  



**Education, Certifications/Licenses:**

*Required* :  



High school diploma or GED


Or


Equivalent academic education and experience  



**Related Work Experience** :  



*Required:* Minimum 2 – 3 years’ experience in a facilities\-related position


*Preferred* : Experience managing small construction\-related or other projects


Applicant may possess a combination of equivalent education and work experience.  



**Specific Skills \& Knowledge:**

*Required* :


* Strong sense of urgency
* Ability to work closely in a team atmosphere or alone
* Good interpersonal skills
* Excellent communication skills, both orally and in written form
* Intermediate proficiency in MS Excel and Word
* Working knowledge of SharePoint
* Excellent customer service skills
* Must be available to work after hours or weekends for facility moves

*Preferred:* Technical knowledge of building systems including HVAC, plumbing, and electrical  



**Working Conditions/Physical Requirements:**

Keyboarding \= 10%\-20%


On\-call \= none


Travel \= 10%\-20%  



*Disclaimer:*

*This information describes the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this job. The description is not designed to be a comprehensive inventory of duties, responsibilities and qualifications required in the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to qualified disabled individuals for performance of essential duties and responsibilities.*


  
**About Southern Company Gas**  

Southern Company Gas is a wholly owned subsidiary of Atlanta\-based Southern Company (NYSE:SO), America’s premier energy company. Southern Company Gas serves approximately 4\.2 million natural gas utility customers through its regulated distribution companies in four states and approximately 600,000 retail customers through its companies that market natural gas. Other nonutility businesses include investments in interstate pipelines and ownership and operation of natural gas storage facilities. For more information, visit southerncompanygas.com .


Southern Company (NYSE: SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry\-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050\.
